Although no record of this town exists in historical records, it has been confirmed by Foundation researchers to have been established since the 1980's. The town's architecture is also identical to that of a typical 80's era society with corresponding technology, media and fashion.

SCP-8083 is a pulsar located within the Cassiopeia constellation approximately 4700 light-years from Earth, provisionally named PSR J0041+5846, with a relatively slow rotation period of 1.322 seconds. SCP-8083 was discovered on 2021/04/19 by the Foundation orbital radio telescope Rubin-MR-2 while monitoring a previously well documented stellar region. Laser measurements indicate that it spans approximately 4% of the province in a roughly rectangular shape, with a natural entrance previously blocked by slate located in the south-western corner. SCP-8154 is approximately 90% flooded with saltwater, and has internal radiative and atmospheric conditions similar to those thought to have been present during the Cambrian period.

SCP-8228 is a glass cake stand, six inches wide and four inches tall. On top of it are six chocolate cupcakes, collectively designated SCP-8228-1. Each SCP-8228-1 instance is topped with colored frosting in flowering shapes. SCP-8228-1 do not appear to decay, go stale, or otherwise deteriorate when left alone. SCP-8230 is believed to be the subject of local legend within the town of Shadesbrook, Yorkshire, and records of sightings have gone back as far as the 1860s.

SCP-8231 is a flower specimen resembling a king protea (Protea cynaroides), albeit with an unusual red color not normally found on the species. When faced with SCP-8231, personnel are known to comment on certain aspects of the anomaly, such as its bright color and uneven petal lengths. A poorly-understood feeling similar to nostalgia is sometimes described by those who spend significant time with SCP-8231.

All victims were between 4 and 9 months of pregnancy when they experienced sudden induced labour and the subsequent disappearance of the foetus. The phenomenon always occurs when the victim is alone.

SCP-8233 shows signs of damage consistent with continuous disuse, abandonment, and neglect over a long period of time.

SCP-8249 designates several entities and their possessions, which appeared in the temporary containment chamber of SCP-████ at Site-87 on March 12, 2024. Despite manifesting within and possessing characteristics typical of Nexus-18, the constituents of SCP-8249 are able to leave the Nexus without degredation of their properties.
SCP-8249-A is a human male individual identified by SCP-8249-C as ‘Adam of the Transient.’ The individual’s skin is completely tattooed with monochromatic, unidentified

SCP-8250 is a 2.5-kilometre squared forested area in Bragg Creek1 Provincial Park. Instead of a regular forest, the area appears to have been replaced by a visually pure black dome. This dome appears to have a smoke-like texture and is in constant motion. The surface of the dome, at last measure, absorbs 99.8% of all light, contributing to the darkness.
The inside of SCP-8250, designated SCP-8250-1 appears to be relatively unchanged. However, there are a few major differences. The biggest change

SCP-8251 is a property of attics that prevents them from being the topmost interior space of a building. Any building that has an attic will necessarily have an interior space located above the attic, designated SCP-8251-A. SCP-8251-A is infinitely large, though it remains inside the building at every point, and is always above the attic. SCP-8251-A can be accessed via unspecified methods.
SCP-8251-A resembles an attic with no ceiling and no means of access to an exterior space. Its appearance a

SCP-8252 is an interconnected phenomenon relating to the simultaneous and anomalous structural changes of human and ant biology in a specific area within the Sahara Desert. SCP-8252-1 refers to affected specimens of Saharan Silver Ants (Cataglyphis bombycina), and SCP-8252-2 refers to the affected humans. SCP-8252 encompasses most of Libya and small portions of Tunisia and Algeria, mostly populated by small villages and settlements. The change in anatomy between the two species is not generation

SCP-8253 is a large, amorphous entity of unknown origins. SCP-8253's appearance is usually of an indistinct ball of light, but often differs in appearance at indeterminate intervals. So far, SCP-8253 has taken the following forms: inanimate objects such as flora, fauna, and humanoid-like figures, as well as abstract forms such as complex, non-euclidean geometric patterns, three-dimensional fractal imagery, and unknown forms of life with unconventional physiologies. However, all of SCP-8253's rec
SCP-8254 refers to the spontaneous anomalous disappearance of Human Resources Deputy Director and Site-37 Human Resources Manager, Ethel Kursh, on April 19th, 2024.

SCP-8255 refers to the collection of entities involved in several events listed in the below table. The only known constant of SCP-8255 is their possession of five legs. Due to a lack of coherence between sources regarding SCP-8255, it is currently unfeasible to fill out the description of this document any further. All information regarding different SCP-8255 sightings is currently in the below table.

SCP-8256 is a large mammalian lifeform native to the North American continent similar to members of the Ursidae and Mustelidae families. SCP-8256 subsists on a diet of nuts, berries, grasses, and members of the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation.
SCP-8256 has several anomalous properties it utilizes to lure prey. Despite these properties interacting with specific complex systems of human society, testing has determined that SCP-8256's intelligence is comparable to most non-anomalous w

SCP-8257 is a phenomenon affecting aerial tramways in the Alps mountain region. SCP-8257 appears as a humanoid male of Scandinavian descent, manifesting at random inside the cabins of active cable cars.

SCP-8258 is an anomalous subspecies of Amanita Muscaria1. Exposure to SCP-8258 spores2 places affected individuals into a cognitively suggestible state, characterized by increased openness to external commands and memory alteration.

SCP-8259 is a creature resembling the Afanc of Welsh folklore, currently located within a stretch of the River Conwy near Betws-y-Coed. SCP-8259 has a head–body length of 1.5 m, with a roughly 0.9 m long tail, weighing roughly 100 kg. Its appearance resembles a cross between a beaver and a crocodile. SCP-8259 is capable of speaking in Middle Welsh.1

SCP-8260 is an early test version of the video game, Warblade MK II, made in unity engine by Edgar M. Vigdal. The author shared the version on his blog on EMV Software Website as a test of the game's performance on various hardware setups.

SCP-8261 is a worn and battered fishing lure that depicts a larger green and red fish in the process of eating a smaller black fish. SCP-8261 measures 7.2cm in length. The anomaly's fishing hooks are rusted, but still sharp. SCP-8261 is significantly weathered, and should be only moved and tested with the utmost of care.

SCP-8262 refers to an event in which all 1,245 students of Andover High School died between the dates of March 18th and March 25th, 2023.

SCP-8263 designates an incurable and progressively intensifying sensation of hunger in individuals diagnosed with severe anorexia nervosa, ultimately leading to anomalous gastric and intestinal growth, deformities, and function. As of writing, SCP-8263 has only manifested in individuals who were notably present in online communities revolving around eating disorders, typically on X or Tumblr.
SCP-8263 commences during periods of binge eating, usually following a fast of one or two weeks. Althoug

SCP-8264 resembles a GE Arrow III passenger train, bearing the “New Jersey Transit” logo on both sides across multiple cars, as well as the number “3399”. Although the number observes standard New Jersey Transit identification protocol, there is no train listed officially under this number.
It has been observed to arrive randomly at various stops along the New Jersey Transit lines in the New York metropolitan area. Though stops at other rail lines in the past have been discovered, every reported

SCP-8265 is a oneirophage phenomenon of anomalous physical distortion. It occurs randomly, although it only affects human subjects and usually Intra-VELO, however the possibility of being afflicted by this anomaly increases with the addition of Risk Factors.

SCP-8266 is a male humanoid 14 years of age, who is capable of knowing the current emotions of any individual it is visually observing. Depending on the emotion observed, the iris of SCP-8266 changes in color.

SCP-8267 refers to a collection of ampoules containing an anomalous compound1 recovered from Area-85.2 Preliminary analysis suggests SCP-8267 is responsible for the events leading to the facility's collapse.

SCP-8268 is an antimemetic phenomenon which can occur in adults who, after a significant period of time living on their own,1 are forced to move back to their hometown into the care of their parents due to some sort of hardship (financial, romantic, etc.),2 resulting in their disappearance and apparent erasure from reality.

SCP-8270 is a collection of 157 human teeth. The teeth have so far been discovered in unusual locations in and around Site-██. None have sustained any damage from the locations they were found in.

SCP-8271 is a male Polyodon spathula, commonly known as the American Paddlefish. SCP-8271 is sapient, and it is capable of instantly destroying any object with a high value. It is unclear where the lower limit is, but the least valuable item destroyed thus far has been Dr. Irkiv's "#1 Site Director" coffee mug1.

It was one of several anomalies resulting from a magnitude 5.8 earthquake that originated in central Virginia, but would be felt in Pennsylvania and Site-898 by proxy. It is a 91.5 cm cane carved from oak, with the steel head of a dragon attached to its handle. A steel ring sits underneath the handle, and is composed of multiple bands of entwined metal. SCP-8280 refers to a species that visually resembles an ankylosaurus (A. magniventris) but is only distantly genetically related.

Before its death, SCP-8286 reportedly sat in a garden surrounded by SCP-8286-1 instances, entertaining them by telling stories, singing songs, reciting poetry, and anomalously producing toys from the folds of its clothing.

SCP-8292 is a phenomenon affecting medical professionals.

SCP-8294 possesses reality bending properties that enable it to affect and erase portions of consensus reality. SCP-8294 can also alter the memories and personalities of sapient lifeforms.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8397 is a humanoid entity formerly known as Erim Durmaz, who was a Foundation researcher and point guard for Site-97's basketball team. It is 2 meters tall, of athletic build, and wears a faded sports jersey.

SCP-8398 resembles a young woman with multiple crustacean characteristics. It possesses numerous chitinous growths scattered across its body, similar in composition to carapaces found in crustacean species. While most growths are broad and flat, the growths emerging from the legs and cranial area are sharp and pointed like spines. SCP-8398 is capable of aquatic respiration — testing has indicated the presence of an apparent branchial chamber within its neck.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8401 is an Ambystoma mexicanum (Axolotl) of average size and weight. It is capable of speech and believed to be sapient, though it has not responded clearly to any lines of questioning or attempt at conversation.

SCP-8402 was discovered living in Washington's Hoh Rainforest in 1998 and moved to Site-19 shortly thereafter. While it is known to be a human or near-human, many details about it are unknown due to an anomaly that impedes direct and indirect observation of it. The explanation currently favored by researchers is that these observations cannot be recalled except when the observer is able to establish a connection between the observed feature of SCP-8402 and themselves or someone they are close to
SCP-8403 is an adult female humanoid of average height and unknown origin. It has dark brown hair and appears to be of Middle Eastern descent.

SCP-8406 possessed latent reality bending capabilities which were not known to the Foundation prior to her disappearance, and which are believed to have been activated by severe emotional distress.

Current Foundation estimates place the number of SCP-8409 speakers anywhere from 200,000 to 700,000, with speaking communities known to exist across all continents (excluding Antarctica). Despite the diversity among these communities, the language is believed to have remarkably small dialect variation, with all currently observed dialects being entirely identical with the exception of a small amount of rarely-used local loanwords.

The mechanism behind this vibration is not thoroughly understood, but it is theorized to represent an extreme manifestation of quantum superpositioning, catalyzed by the away-facing hemisphere's relative size and proximity to the population of Earth, coupled with its total lack of visibility to said population. All instances of SCP-8417 have been found within the continental United States. Despite the latest instance being discovered more than a full year after his death, all corpses are in similar states of decay.

SCP-8418 is a now-defunct supermarket in Trenton, New Jersey, containing a musical cognitohazard designated 'SCP-8418-A'. SCP-8418-A plays from the speaker system of SCP-8418 at all times.
As a person listens to SCP-8418-A, the anomaly makes contact with the subconscious, shifting into an entirely unique composition by attuning to the perception of the listener. SCP-8418-A's objective contents3 are unknown for this reason, though there are consistent reports of the initial track being classical.

His most distinguishing feature is his fashion sense, and he displays a preference for custom clock-themed Victorian-era suits; like other members of the House of Stars, he is a known customer of the Master Tailor.

Growths are notable for their conical bell-shaped cap with a small white spot on the peak. The colour of the growth ranges from brown to a rust-like colour. Incidences of missing persons cases recorded after SCP-8424 incidents are significantly higher than projected for events of their size. The nature of SCP-8425 remains unclear, but appears to be similar in nature to paranoid schizophrenia, incorporating symptoms that outwardly appear similar.

Due to an ontological shift, the (The following statement is improbable): function and purpose of SCP-8426 has been lost, and any related documentation is no longer conceptually associated with the object. Uncovering the function of this object is the primary goal.

SCP-8427 is an object bearing a perfect resemblance to a spoon; its molecular makeup, structure, and physical characteristics are identical to those of a spoon.
SCP-8428 is Alexander Kovacs, a 3-year-old boy living in Bunbury, WA, Australia.
Item 8429 is a formal three-piece outfit consisting of a white jacket, black waistcoat, and white trousers, all in Men’s Medium (US) size, and with ‘Doctor’s Orders’ sewn into all tags.

The facility began exhibiting anomalous qualities following a buyout of Ellison Health by U.S.-based drugmaker Purdue Pharma in 2023.

This is achieved through a program constructed in Python, though the copy obtained by Foundation agents seems to lack any anomalous aspects, and thus functionality. SCP-8434, referenced in CIA documentation with the cryptonym MHFIST, is an entry referring to two items: an individual pamphlet supposedly written by Jedidiah Morse in 1812 then rediscovered in 1997; and a collection of possibly fabricated tablets discovered in New Haven, CT in 1945, thought to be furbished from a French brass tea kettle when examined yet bearing a strong resemblance to the former item. SCP-8438 was a species of flower related to Wisteria floribunda. After penetrating the skin or being inhaled, SCP-8438's spores migrated to the central nervous system, where it established a seed structure. Over a period of 12 to 24 hours, infected tissue was gradually replaced by flowering plant matter genetically similar to species of angiosperms; the angiosperms demonstrated the capacity to regenerate lost or damaged limbs.

SCP-8439 is a collection of entities functioning under a shared consciousness. Manifestations of SCP-8439 are confined to currently contained to Site-143-B, and can take on a variety of forms. Forms favored by SCP-8439 include a swarm of ravens, a collection of eyes, and a rope noose. SCP-8439 also has the ability to dampen artificial light sources in its vicinity. All light sources within 500 meters of SCP-8439 either cease to function or are incapable of exceeding 90 lumens.

SCP-8441 is an organism resembling a healthy Norway spruce (Picea abies) of around eighty years of age. It is situated near █████, Sweden, in an area that was formerly a commercial spruce plantation, but following a clearcutting in 1988, has lain fallow until eventually becoming colonized by various native pioneer tree species, primarily silver birch (Betula pendula).

All discoveries tied to these events have so far been deceased, with the remains heavily rotted or completely decayed. So far, instances of SCP-8446 have been found throughout the Appalachian Mountains, all of which were composed of native Cervidae.1

SCP-8453 was discovered by J. Researcher Davids on April 15th, 2023. Loud thudding noises were heard behind a shelf, the removal of which uncovered the hatch.

Prolonged exposure to SCP-8454 induces visual and verbal auditory hallucinations, feelings of extreme paranoia, dread, and guilt, self-harm, and suicidal ideation. SCP-8454 was discovered after the unexplained disappearance of the ranch house's former inhabitants, Erin and Jonathon Moore. When a physical item is placed near SCP-8455 and left untouched for several moments, the object will make a series of observations, typically related to the item's previous owners and usage.

In order to activate this service, a specific ten-digit number must be entered into a device capable of two-way verbal communication. A white label is haphazardly plastered to its side with the words ‘Box O’ Bones’ written in black ‘whiteboard marker’ upon it.

SCP-8482 consists of seven descending rows of pews around a central raised platform, on top of which are two rostrums spaced ten meters apart. Centered between these two stands is a three edged arena, with the edge facing the pews being open and lacking a guardrail.
SCP-8482's primary anomaly manifests when a debate is held within it.2 Once a debate has begun, a disembodied

SCP-8483 is a Class V positively aligned superintelligence capable of high-level data sorting and correlation analysis. This artificial intelligence is localized to a specific USB 3.0 connected external drive with an unknown storage capacity. Currently, this external drive is attached to a desktop computer that has over 20 terabytes of storage.

The body possesses minor scratches and a vague layer of grime that cannot be removed, and the bristles are worn to an excessive degree, twisted in various directions. SCP-8487 is a singular, distinct, continuous entity documented to have existed since at least 430 BCE (±60 years). The anomaly is entirely composed of physically realized information, such as human writing, and commonly presents as a group of symbols; when in physical contact with other created symbols, SCP-8487 is able to self-incorporate them. All information incorporable by SCP-8487 has been designated "SCRIPT"2. Incorporation involves SCP-8487 restructuring itself to maximize internal comple

SCP-8488 refers to an advertisement utilizing the children’s entertainment mascot ‘Birthday Bash’. The Birthday Bash brand includes a toy line, a television series, a movie, a children’s birthday party mascot service, and other products and services themed after the character. No other products or services besides SCP-8488 featuring Birthday Bash have been deemed anomalous.

SCP-8489 is the collective designation for two left hands, severed at the wrist, which were recovered from the personal apartment of Site-86 Ethics Committee Liaison Henri Cosztonne. Both instances of SCP-8489 are anomalously preserved, having shown no signs of decomposition during their time in Foundation custody. However, both instances are susceptible to damage, and neither has been observed to heal or bleed.

SCP-8491 refers to a █████ tree locating on a terraced hillside in a disputed rural zone within the Daffah Territories. Standard dendrochronological analysis of the tree have proven unreliable due to irregular growth rings and continuous internal regeneration.
SCP-8491 exhibits extraordinary resilience to physical harm, such as fire, slashing, and uprooting. Damage from such events is consistently reversed within 72 hours. During periods of damage and recovery, SCP-8491 continuously exudes a vis

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8493 is a conceptual entity that metaphysically 'inhabits' a single concept at any point in time. This host concept is designated as SCP-8493-A.

SCP-8494 is a 3-story house in Arizona, approximately 16 miles west of Sedona. The object itself was discovered after the Foundation purchased the property and the surrounding area for a new Site. A mailbox stands in front of the house; while there had apparently been words painted on it, they have long since faded and chipped away. Occasionally, members of the SCP Foundation will receive calls inviting them to visit the house.
The interior of SCP-8494 is completely dark; visual light is incapab

SCP-8495 is the current designation for a rampant phenomenon affecting Foundation personnel. SCP-8495 consists of two separate anomalies, henceforth designated SCP-8495-1 events, and SCP-8495-2 manifestations. Although all current and former Foundation personnel have the potential to be the subject of an SCP-8495-1 event, their likelihood of experiencing an event can increase when a number of factors are met.

The subject has behaved morally, and/or ethically.

The anomaly has only been observed within the confines of a specific type of location; it describes these as "islands", researchers have designated them SCP-8496-B3. SCP-8496-B instances are invariably shelters of flora and fauna at a higher density than the surrounding area. Individuals passing through it experience one of the eight possible hallucinative scenarios. In them, they re-live the memories, together with the accompanying emotional and physical sensations,. SCP-8501 is an extra-planar entity that to date has always taken the form of a type of vehicle belonging to the "Isuzu Elf" brand of trucks manufactured and sold in Japan. The most common form is usually the sixth-generation hi-cab box truck though it has used variants in the series of vehicles such as vans, different styles of trucks, and an ambulance variant. It is currently unknown why it prefers to manifest in this form.
Upon manifestation of an instance of SCP-8501, a unique burst of Akiva

SCP-8502 is a male human, thirty-nine years of age, approximately 1.65 meters in height, and 52 kg in weight. SCP-8502 is the last Homo sapiens. Born to GoI-7112-G, it is believed that airborne wasting viruses and harsh winters led to social fracturing, causing SCP-8502 to leave the group with its mother at age ten. By 9914, SCP-8502 was the last living human.
SCP-8502 lives a semi-nomadic lifestyle in a roughly 150 square kilometer area in the southeast of Sector KU1 (designated as the Preserve

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8503-ᛒ, designated as the 'Valkyrie Model' by the Valravn Corporation, are cybernetically enhanced human organisms created for combat applications.

SCP-8504 refers to an anomalous series of pop-up windows that manifests randomly on computers. SCP-8504 usually takes the form of a girl in the Japanese anime style, particularly a popular style from the early 2000s. SCP-8504 is capable of communicating with subjects through the screen of the affected device via speaking aloud. When SCP-8504 speaks, its voice sounds as if it is coming out of a muffled microphone. It has been observed that SCP-8504 can only manifest itself in one place at a time.

SCP-8505 is the designation for a humanoid amalgam roughly 1.6 m in height, given name Percival Godwin or "Percy," as it insists. SCP-8505's physical form is comprised of remains from several preserved cadavers in varying states of decomposition, assembled with rough accuracy using a number of mundane materials.2 Despite its condition, SCP-8505 displays no pain or negative physical complications aside from occasional "structural indiscretions," such as losing a limb mid-gesture. SCP-8506 is a helix-shaped stairway built out of an anomalous, seemingly indestructible crystalline material. The structure is 5 metres tall and has a diameter of 10 metres. Despite its size, SCP-8506 weighs only 424.5 tons, making it extremely lightweight for its size and physical properties.

data.titleJP: You Must be This Tall… To Die!
data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8507 was the Wunder Coaster at Wunderpark, located in Janisse, Missouri. Composed primarily of wood, SCP-8507 spanned 607 meters in length and possessed a height of 61 meters, with a drop off of 50 meters at this highest point.

SCP-8508 is a small wooden box resembling a jewellery or trinket box. The words ‘1 Timothy 6:10’1 have been carved into the back of the lid. There are no other marks on SCP-8508’s surface, or any lock or catch. SCP-8508 was found by police in an abandoned house in [REDACTED], New South Wales, along with a number of projects in various states of completion. After being brought to the Foundation's attention by police liaison, SCP-8508 was transferred to Area-57. Analysis of the available security

SCP-8509 is a phenomenon able to affect the majority of animal species. Currently, the only factor known to influence an SCP-8509 event happening is a diversity index greater than the average index of the surrounding area(s), though this is not a necessity.
An SCP-8509 event is described as the rapid rise in population of a non-dominant species over a period of 8 to 12 weeks1, succeeded by a subsequent decrease of the affected species2 to levels close to or below their original ones. In all reco

SCP-8511 was a cognitive hazard that infected staff within Site-17, manifested within the idea of a Foundation worker’s strike. Individuals seemed to believe that they were being treated 'unfairly’ for the services they provide, and continually progressed in their contempt to the point where they refused to work until unrealistic demands were met.
Demands include but are not limited to:

Dental.


Hazard Pay.


Renegotiation on PTO policies.


Compensation for the families of staff killed on sit

SCP-8513 je mrtvé tělo Výzkumníka Luka Graysona, které aktuálně prochází procesem oživení. Pokusy oživení SCP-8513 zpomalit jsou neúčinné, neboť jakékoliv způsobené poškození je pouze dočasné.

SCP-8514 describes a singular entity adopting three separate variants. In descending commonality of appearance, they are listed as follows:



Variant-1 is a bearded humanoid entity of tall2, muscular stature, typically residing in the American mid-and-northwest, and regions of rural Canada. It primarily occupies itself with logging and reforesting, though occasionally it integrates itself with locals, passing itself off as a lumberjack. Variant-1 is occasionally accompanied by SCP-8514-A, an ab

SCP-8515 is an entity that currently inhabits the corpse of Dr. Franklin Brollis. The origin of SCP-8515, the physical form of SCP-8515 (or lack thereof) distinct from the corpse of Dr. Brollis, and the circumstances of Dr. Brollis' death are all currently unknown.
The ongoing influence of SCP-8515 on the remains of Dr. Brollis has produced increasingly stark changes to the structure of the body. Notable alterations include:

Resistance to decomposition;
Drastically enhanced flexibility and mobi
SCP-8516 is a collection of 12 household objects of varying types and origins, a summary inventory of which may be found in Addendum 1.
Event and involved materials remain poorly understood due to their ambiguous, possibly subjective nature. SCP-8517 is known to have occurred on 2026-05-27.

SCP-8518 is an idea that abruptly appeared in the noosphere on April 23, 2021 and has remained there since. It is a static view of a brick tower several stories tall, lit from the upper left. SCP-8518 is present in the psyche of every human; the average person recalls SCP-8518 once every two minutes of their own volition. It has proven impossible to dispel even with the use of amnestics and targeted countermemes.
Apart from its omnipresence and unusual persistence in the mental landscape, SCP-85

SCP-8519 refers to a youth organization for girls developed by GOI-4319 (“Just Girly Things”) titled the “Sprinkle Scouts”. SCP-8519 has troops stationed all over the United States and Canada, although no set locations have been identified. However, members of SCP-8519 have been discovered by the Foundation.
SCP-8519-A refers to the members of SCP-8519. SCP-8519-A instances have the capability to sell and produce cookies at an impossible rate for the average human. Exact numbers are unknown, but

SCP-8520 is the collective delusion held by most of humanity that the Earth has a natural satellite in its orbit, known as the Moon. Although some individuals show some natural immunity to SCP-8520's effects, the vast majority of the population will be unable to perceive the actual nature of SCP-8520, no matter the length of observation or proximity to the area which the Moon is assumed to exist.2 The strength of this effect extended to the manned Apollo Lunar Missions of the twentieth century,

SCP-8521 is a brown, █████████ brand lever recliner chair, estimated to have been built sometime between the 1990’s and 2000’s. The chair is made of woven fabric and the reclining lever a fine oak wood, although chips in the wood show signs of aging. The Latin phrase, “Praeteritum Plene Praesens Est”, can be seen engraved into the lever’s handle.
When a person sits in SCP-8521 with the recliner activated for approximately one minute, they will experience heavy drowsiness and quickly enter REM sl
AO-8522 is a champagne cork stopper. When inserted into an alcoholic bottle, the container will replenish itself with the corresponding beverage.1

SCP-8524 is a scrapbook with a leather cover, with dimensions of approximately 30cm x 40cm, weighing 0.45kg when measured.1 All attempts to alter the cover in any way have proven unsuccessful. Internal pages can be destroyed, removed, or altered, but reappear in their original state when the cover is closed and reopened.


Documented Page 15 of SCP-8524 when interacting with D-1159


Upon direct skin contact, SCP-8524’s pages manifest photographs, ephemera2 and handwritten annotations correspond

SCP 8527 is a large open-pit asbestos mine, covering an estimated surface area of approximately 9 km². SCP 8527 is located within a taiga forest on the outskirts of ██████, Sverdlovsk Oblast, Russian Federation. To prevent discovery by civilians, all satellite imagery and public cartographic records of SCP-8577 have been altered. The entire mining area has been replaced with forest terrain consistent with the surrounding biome. On official documentation, the area of SCP 8527 is listed as federal
SCP-8528 refers to a localized, spontaneous anomalous event involving the microscopic mites Demodex folliculorum and D. brevis2 residing on the body of Researcher James Fernandez.
SCP-8529 refers to the charred skeletal remains of an adult Felis catus (domestic cat) of undetermined age and breed. It measures 24-centimeters in height and 58-centimeters in length.

SCP-8530 is the city Maladh (ملاذ) located in Egypt from the moment of its creation until Incident-8530-G. It was built by SCP-8530-A on top of a small desert village over the course of 10 years. It has transformed into a tourism hotspot famous for skyscrapers like the Spiral and the Moon next to projects like Maladh Center Mall, the largest cinema complex in Egypt and the Greenhouse Towers. The original village and its small population have since been entirely displaced.
SCP-8530-A is Mirza Qad

SCP-8531 is a road sign, formerly located on the Minnesota-North Dakota border along Highway 210. Under normal circumstances, it reads "Welcome to North Dakota" with the subtitle "LEGENDARY", similar to other such signs. However, at irregular intervals, its text will change to read "welcome to FUNNY" for roughly 2.2 seconds. Any human who witnesses this and reads the altered text will become an instance of SCP-8531-1.
Comedic material (jokes, etc.) produced by SCP-8531-1 will change to reflect a

SCP-8532 is a sudden event that can occur to human beings who are alone in their homes at night.1 For this event to occur, a complicated set of conditions must be met. These conditions are listed below,2 and have been roughly arranged in the order the victim is likely to fulfill them chronologically.

The individual must be tired.
The individual must not have any immediate need to leave the house, such as a fire.
The individual must not have any plans to leave the house for the rest of the night
SCP-8533 is a disease affecting human populations. It is characterized by a wide variety of behavioral disorders, mostly relating to an unusual infatuation with horses.

SCP-8534 was the football1 match played on 14/09/1978 between amateur clubs Eastbridge Athletic and Harrow Vale FC at the now-demolished Eastbridge Municipal Stadium. The final score of SCP-8534 was 16.4 - 3.

Item 8536 is a human male of Caucasian descent, approximately 20 years of age. The words "Mr. Watches, from Little Misters ® by Dr. Wondertainment" are tattooed on the Item's right outer wrist. Item 8536 presents a mustache structurally analogous to the hands of a clock: the left end corresponds to the minute hand and the right end to the hour hand, joined at a single central point located immediately above the upper lip, functioning as an axis. Both ends rotate clockwise along this axis autonom

During this time, at least 537 physically identical anomalous entities2 (designated SCP-8537-1) were permitted to vote within the state, with all instances casting their vote for Republican candidate George W. Bush.

SCP-8541 was discovered by Foundation surface agents following a contemporaneously prominent double-murder case in Spokane, Washington, USA, on 03-18-1979. The pre- and post-homicide circumstances suggested plausibly supernatural cause to local authorities, thus triggering Foundation intervention. Assessment of the crime scene by Foundation personnel justified SCP designation and subsequent acquisition. All involved extraveil individuals were amnesticized and released from custody.

SCP-8544 designates a single anomalous event that affected Dr. Monika Veidni during a bout of recurrent sleep paralysis.

SCP-8545 is a sketch scrawled on a singular sheet of beige colored construction paper. Analysis of the material the anomaly was designed on has determined that the "origin" of the anomaly is fixated specifically within the sketch itself. For all intents and purposes, the construction paper itself is entirely non-anomalous.

Item found in vicinity of corpse shortly after incident, recovered and moved to Site-19.

SCP-8547 is a human infant possessing ontokinetic abilities with no known limit. Prior to Foundation intervention, it was capable of producing CK-class reality restructuring events in accordance with how it viewed the world. SCP-8548 refers to a probabilistic anomaly that manifests when SCP-8548-1 and SCP-8548-2 interact with one another. Whenever both entities are placed directly in front of each other and begin to act aggressively towards one another, it causes several probabilistic errors to occur.
Any object or event within the radius of SCP-8548 will result in undesirable outcomes, such as some form of destruction or otherwise catastrophe.
Though the nature of SCP-8548 has caused several failures at Site-225, S

SCP-8549 is a species of fungus discovered in ██████, Ohio, within the basement of an abandoned house. All SCP-8549 infections can be traced back to the house, which is considered the epicenter of SCP-8549. The house is in decay; large growths of SCP-8549 have burst through the roof and walls.
SCP-8549 is parasitic towards mammals, growing rapidly in and around its host's organs. The fungi keeps its host alive via anomalous means, and will continue to do so even if the host suffers catastrophic

SCP-8551 is a copy of Herman Melville’s Moby-Dick, printed by Dover Publications in 2003 as an entry in the ‘Dover Giant Thrift Editions’ series. Physically, SCP-8551 resembles any other copy of Moby-Dick produced as a part of that same print run,. Although investigations carried out by researchers at Site-12 involved buying up all available copies of the long-since out-of-print Giant Thrift edition, only SCP-8551 has displayed anomalous properties. in roughly Good condition,. SCP-8554 is a triadic pyramid located in the ancient Maya city of Calakmul, often referred to as Structure II. SCP-8554's base measures 120m2 and stands at 45 meters tall. Located in the remains of Structure-2A of SCP-8554 are two indestructible, immovable boxes made of limestone. Despite their unbreakable nature, one box is open and was presumably looted; the remaining box is still unopened, however, all attempts to view the contents of it have been unsuccessful. In addition to these anomalous

SCP-8555 is a cylindric artifact with a diameter of ~20 meters, and an overall height of ~30 meters, with some intricate subordinate mechanical structures attached to its main part upon its discovery.

SCP-[PENDING] is an Electronika-508 Video model reel-tape recorder, developed by the Soviet Ministry of Electronic Industry. SCP-[PENDING]’s physical properties align with reel-to-reel recorders of a similar make, both in appearance and functionality. The play button is replaced with a misprinted inverted triangle enclosed within a circle, presumed to be a production mistake.
When used to play a compatible tape recording, SCP-[PENDING] generates an anomalous effect within a 15m radius. To observ
SCP-8557 is a biological phenomenon wherein continuous self-mutilation can cause recent wounds to become sapient oral cavities capable of sustained and coherent communication.

SCP-8559 is hypothesized to be a metaphysical entity that follows a number of laws, which have all been discovered through their violation. There may be laws enacted by SCP-8559 that are currently undiscovered but are legally binding. As of 06/23/2024, SCP-8559 is located at Biological Research Site-129, a low-risk containment and research facility housing approximately thirty SCP objects handled by the Biology Department and the Synthology Department.

SCP-8560 is a humanoid male of South-African descent (previously known as Josef Enzokuhle), aged at approximately 65 years old, measured at 5'5ft, with brown eyes, grey hair and a slender build. SCP-8560 exhibits severe emotional and psychological instability, slipping in and out of depressive episodes at random. Most attempts to prevent these episodes via the use of medicine fail. However, administering anti-depressants and psychotics has been shown to delay the onset of these attacks by weeks

SCP-8561 refers to the statue situated at the highest point of Castel Sant'Angelo, in Vatican City, Rome (Italy). At first glance, SCP-8561 appears to be made entirely of weathered bronze with subsequent structural alterations, and is mounted on a base of carved and polished stone.

SCP-8562 refers to the town of San Bartolomé Mártir in the state of [REDACTED], México. As of the year 2025, it has a population of 98,382 persons, of which approximately 71% are known to be instances of SCP-8562-1: individuals who possess the innate ability of fleshcrafting.4

SCP-8563 is a young human girl. There are things wrong with it, so it has to be tested for issues. It is incapable of sitting in its cell and being quiet, so don't be afraid of hurting it when escorting it to and from its cell. Sometimes, all it does is sit in its cell and be quiet, which is not what we want either. Nobody wants SCP-8563 for too long.
Sometimes, when SCP-8563 reads books, it imagines itself like the characters in those books. The books change so that SCP-8563 is the characters.

SCP-8564-1 refers to any of 32 explosive devices that were dropped on major cities worldwide on 29 January, 1964. SCP-8564-1’s technology has not been identified, though it bears resemblance to the Foundation’s own former nuclear initiative, Project AEDile. Despite resembling modern weaponry, SCP-8564-1’s payload is paranormal and cannot be recreated, but releases heavy levels of radiation along with its other effects. Drop sites continue to emit radiation in quantities up to one sievert.

SCP-8565 are beverage cans that contain the anomalous memetic agent Root-311. It is unknown how many of these cans are currently in circulation.

SCP-8566 is a mechanical full-body suit of 'Absolute Exclusion Harness' specially designed for surviving in a potential K-class scenario and hiding from possible predatory entities. You are able and encouraged to record journal entries throughout your trip for the SCP Foundation deepwell archive. You have been selected in order to carry out the mission of saving the world.

SCP-8570 is a house located on the outskirts of [REDACTED], ██, which appears to have been converted from domestic use for an unclear purpose at some point in the past. This includes the removal of the back door and all windows, which were subsequently filled in and/or boarded up. The structural integrity of SCP-8570 has been considerably compromised by fire, and the roof has collapsed in several parts of the house. It was constructed sometime during the 18th century through various thaumaturgic and alchemical engineering methods, and has since been utilized by the Romanov dynasty and the Soviet government to serve the interests of the Russian Empire and USSR until SCP-8572-1's expiration sometime around 1991.

SCP-8575 is a large muscular adhesion1 located beneath the left pectoralis major of Dr. John Davidson. The affected tissue is severely damaged, covering a total area of 320 cm2.
When viewed using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), the tissue visibly resembles the facial features of an adolescent human male. It is unclear if these features correspond to those of a living person. Investigations into the identity of the individual pictured are ongoing.

After several minutes of exposure, SCP-8577 induces a wayfinding loop oriented toward the amenity currently promoted. Individuals who have checked in and are presently affected are designated SCP-8577-1.

SCP-8580 denotes baroque1 pearls distinguished by their comparatively low conchiolin and high mucin contents. Instances are hollow, containing a small pocket of stale air at their centers instead of a solid nucleus.2 These factors render SCP-8580 instances fragile in comparison to commercial counterparts.

SCP-8582 are a pair of shoes that do not belong to you. They are size █, which is notably too small for you to comfortably wear. They are not practical footwear for everyday use, nor are they generally considered stylish or fashionable. There is no indication that the wearing of SCP-8582 would improve your life in any tangible way. There is every indication that the wearing of SCP-8582 would cause inconvenience for yourself and those around you.

SCP-8675 refers to a flock of 6,500 paper birds. Each individual instance is different, but all appear intentionally created. They can be comprised of different types of paper with various designs, colors, or writings on them, and various folding or drawing styles. When exposed to open air or in the presence of other SCP-8675 instances, the entities behave in a pattern much more similar to that of wild birds. This includes migratory and flocking behavior coordinated over long distances. SCP-8675
SCP-8677 is a black television remote of unknown model. It randomly replaces other non-anomalous remote control devices within Site-01.

SCP-8678 is currently believed to be an entity or number of entities that reside along the northern coast of Alaska and Canada. These entities differ slightly in general appearance, though common characteristics include pale-green skin; a flat face with reduced or no visible nostrils; long black hair and fingernails; and prominent aquatic features, such as fins or webbed fingers/toes. SCP-8679 is the nomenclature assigned to a thaumaturgical molecule whose properties are not currently identified. Given the conditions of the discovery of the compound and the state of degradation due to exposure to high temperatures, it is impossible to replicate or understand its structure in its entirety.

SCP-8680 is a device developed by Dr. Claire Somme known as a 'Somme Dimensional Anchor' (or SDA). SCP-8680 functions through the emission of pre-selected anomalous radiation, specifically chosen to be harmless. This emission, over time, overpowers and replaces the much more dangerous dimensional radiation naturally present.
Update: As of the dimensional collapse of SBS-44, the chosen emission source has been replaced with non-anomalous uranium. Dr. Somme is not to be informed of this change.

SCP-8681 is the portfolio of all financial and political capital invested in PHLOX Inc. (See Section 2 for more details.) Being the preeminent Foundation investment of the decade, SCP-8681's success is of critical importance to the Foundation's image and finances. Additionally, control of SCP-8681 enables the Foundation to monitor the use of the PHLOX highway. This access is critical to tracking the movement of Groups of Interest, Persons of Interest, and Socially Transmissible anomalies.

SCP-8682 resembles a headless, 11 week old human fetus. SCP-8682 is calcified and exhibits complete cephalothoracic fusion. SCP-8682 is 4.5 cm in length, has a craniocaudal length of 8 cm, and a weight of 20g. SCP-8682 is stored in a 15x15cm archival plastic container. The container is stained with green bile and red with blood, fluids discharged from the liver of SCP-8682 immediately before its death. SCP-8683 is the intelligence responsible for adaptive immunity in vertebrate organisms. During immune responses, it restructures the DNA of B-cells within Germinal Centres1 to produce antibodies specific to encountered pathogens and toxins.

SCP-8684 is an unidentified human female who is capable of involuntary reflexive movement of dismembered body parts. This ability has been observed to happen spontaneously even in the absence of any nervous or muscular tissue in the body part in question. Likewise, SCP-8684’s dismembered body parts have been observed to be resistant (but not immune) to chemical changes, up to and including decay and digestion. SCP-8685 is an organization of anomalous humans capable of medically removing and restoring wasted organs for recycled usage in humans. SCP-8685 instances do not originate from our timeline nor dimension, but do not physically differ from baseline humans. The exact methodology in which they are able to refurbish organs is unknown.
SCP-8685's mission statement is to provide preserve and save lives of individuals from their dimension.

Due to its concealed nature, SCP-8696's size is difficult to estimate, but it is large enough to envelop a human being inside of itself with little to no strain. Its limbs are covered in various pieces of clothing, and the items usually correspond with the limbs they are on (i.e. arms in shirts and legs in pants).

It was discovered by the Department of Down during reclamation and expansion work at Area-86, buried two meters beneath the Director's Office (itself fifty meters below the surface of the Namib Desert). When sand was removed from its lungs, SCP-8697 became responsive.

data.titleJP: Every Day I See You Still
data.descriptionExcerpt:
SCP-8699 is a continuous series of anomalous events surrounding Sirius Reverend following the death of Vivian Reverend on July 27th, 2013. These events typically manifest while Reverend is home alone, but have manifested in multiple other locations, and, in rare cases, in front of other people.
A brief list of manifestations has been compiled by Researcher Jack Simmons, on the behalf of Sirius Reverend, below. For a full list, please refer to document 8699-Events.

data.titleJP: In the Court of the Dragon

The stone is anomalously hard, measuring 10 on the Mohs hardness scale, and bears faded Latin engravings upon its surface. From what can be observed from the door to the building's central corridor, the interior of SCP-8702 is a lightless cave composed of a white, chalky substance that has yet to be identified. Natural rock formations in the cave take the shape of the contents of the dentist's office that once occupied Suite 315.
The cave extends beyond the reaches of the suite's southern-facing wind

- A scimitar piercing the abdomen of a Turkish soldier.

- A sword lodged in a stone1.

Disappearances cannot be explained by factors like weather, malfunctioning equipment, or poor navigation/decision-making. Disappearances are associated with moderate sized groups of ships. No existing wrecks corresponding to craft that have vanished as a consequence of SCP-8705 have been recovered.

It is suspected that the city itself, due to its rich cultural and historic traditions, is directly responsible for this effect. Watson", recounting his discovery of SCP-8712-B, and his involvement in Incident 8712-1, notably seeming to involve an anomalous GOI. SCP-8713 events are presented as live art performances. The content of each event is highly variable and consistently falls outside of what might be expected from such performances. Consistent factors of events include the presence of POI-8713, as well as witnesses being unable to conceive of concepts such as “horror”, “atrocity” and “bad art” for the duration. As a result, actions carried out as part of an SCP-8713 event are always received positively, regardless of societal or artistic merit.

SCP-8714 is a collection of objects retrieved from the estate belonging to the late Lord Alexander Brandt III,2 in Northumberland, UK. The SCP-8714 collection was found in a chamber behind a hidden door in the manor's basement after a fire consumed the property, resulting in Lord Brant's demise.

SCP-8715 is a 1.23-litre, black ceramic vase of indeterminate origin. When any liquid is introduced into the object, it is anomalously diminished at a rate inconsistent with any known form of natural evaporation or absorption.

SCP-8716 is a digital anomaly capable of ontological displacement, whereby victims are displaced from baseline reality into a digital pocket universe. It targets individuals engaging with video sharing platforms. Manifestations are identified by the addition of "/theslugw1tch" in contaminated video URLs.
The SCP-8716 phenomenon primarily manifests in videos aimed at relaxation; how the target is chosen is unknown. Targets of SCP-8716 also do not appear aware of the SCP-8716 phenomenon, and in th
SCP-8717 is a fountain pen of luxury quality named “Libra”, housed in a mahogany gift box, using a standard piston converter made of reinforced glass to contain the ink.

SCP-8718 is an anomalous species of vine native to the Republic of South Africa suspected to be from the genus, Ceropegia. The species is currently unidentified, but is visually similar to Ceropegia ampliata.

SCP-8719 is a parasite which inhibits human fear responses by attacking the amygdala and hypothalamus. It reproduces asexually in most mammals, but only causes behavioral changes in Homo sapiens. Risk factors include tainted blood, organ transplants, and undercooked meat.
After a variable incubation period, symptoms develop in phases:

Stage 1 — lessened anxiety, reduced inhibitions, and increased pleasure-seeking behavior. Peers often perceive this as a positive development, complicating diagno

When observed by independent sapient subjects, SCP-8721's physical appearance will exhibit either male or female sex characteristics.

SCP-8723 refers to two objects found near the town of Caldes de Vall, in the Spanish Pyrenees. SCP-8723-1 is an exceptionally large skeleton of Capra Pyrenaica,3 measuring 10 meters long. SCP-8723-2 is a porcelain statue of a red cherub with four wings. It is believed to be the remnants of a destroyed paraweapon of unknown manufacture, absorbing 0.5 Akiva per minute. SCP-8723-2 is currently lodged into the neck of SCP-8723-1.

As a result of SCP-8725, SCP-8725-B is unable to speak of how she lost SCP-8725-A, and the aforementioned claims to possess no memory of the event. Additionally, as a result of SCP-8725, SCP-8725-B was able to finish her Foundation PhD. When expos

[DATA EXPUNGED]

SCP-8731 designates a self-contained pocket universe whose primary entrance is located somewhere within the Carpathian Mountains, near the city of Brașov, Romania. SCP-8731 is a Free-Port type Nexus3 inhabited exclusively by members of Species of Interest #6425 ("Zadotek"). Further details regarding the object and its inhabitants are unknown.
SCP-8732 is a worn 3x3x3 meter box composed of an indeterminate metal with a single plain door of similar composition on one face.
SCP-8733 is an Automatic Products Model 113 vending machine. It will dispense a human body once a week.

SCP-8734 is D-7794, formerly known as Owen Hunt, a 31-year-old (at time of designation) Maryland resident with a documented history of substance dependency, convicted of the murder of Corwin Tristan Halsey on 17 January 2023. On this date, Hunt shot and killed Halsey in front of Halsey's house in Anne Arundel, Maryland, USA.1 A notebook with a thick, black cover was found in Hunt's possession immediately after the murder. Every page other than the final page of this notebook were filled with not

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8785 is a butter chicken curry intended to have been consumed by Dr. Smith for lunch. Accounts of SCP-8785’s flavor profile have been erratic throughout testing, with only Dr. Smith having been capable of offering a consistent description of the true nature of SCP-8785. Whether or not SCP-8785 is sentient and specifically challenges Dr. Smith’s ability or elects to spare other Foundation personnel is unknown and is subject of further testing.

SCP-9040 is the collective designation for a population of Blattella germanica:2 individually designated SCP-9040-01 through SCP-9040-53. Instances exhibit sapience, fluent vocal speech, anthropomorphic behavior, and significantly extended lifespans. All wear garments consistent with late-18th century European maritime fashion, typically accessorized with sewing needles in place of swords and miniature firecrackers in place of pistols.

SCP-9043 is a pair of socks, featuring a light brown and navy blue striped pattern.

SCP-9044 bylo poprvé objeveno po zmizení každého člena rodiny Loreyových, k čemuž pravděpodobně došlo během kolaudačního večírku. Všech 27 hostů je následovalo dovnitř. Jejich vozidla zůstávají zaparkovaná

SCP-9045 is an anomalous retrocausal phenomenon by which unknown individuals (SCP-9045-1) appear within media and documentation (such as newspapers, photographs, birth certificates, and marriage licenses). Despite their appearance being near-identical to known individuals, the identities of these instances cannot be corroborated or confirmed by anyone1, beyond stating that they "look like someone they've seen before."

SCP-9046 is alive.

SCP-9047 is a male Cardigan Welsh corgi1 which is identical to any other dog of its breed, with the exception of its exceptional longevity and apparent total immunity to physical trauma and pathogens (whether anomalous or non-anomalous), rendering it incapable of carrying or transmitting any infectious agents. Besides this, SCP-9047 displays no unusual behavior, and exhibits standard behavioral responses to positive and negative stimuli—with the exception of exposure to pathogens or physical har

SCP-9048 is the collective designation for SCP-9048-1, “The Banksworth Theatre”, and SCP-9048-2 instances, individuals who have previously been exposed to a performance within SCP-9048-1. Every year, within one week of May 1st, SCP-9048-1 will manifest and draw in an audience to watch the upcoming performance. This occurrence has been designated as the "Ouroboros Event".

SCP-9049 is a limit on the total number of human teeth that can exist on Earth at any given time. The precise value of this limit is not known, though estimates have placed it at around 7.0*10¹². When the number of human teeth on Earth exceeds SCP-9049, no new teeth will develop; this affects the growth of deciduous and permanent teeth as well as all known anomalous dental sources. SCP-9049 was first reached on October 19th, 2049; the Total Tooth Count (TTC) did not dip below SCP-9049 until May

SCP-9051 is a 1 fluid ounce elliptical bottle labeled "Spa Therapy Shampoo". The fluid inside the bottle has been identified as identical to non-anomalous shampoo. The fluid within the bottle can be removed and used as shampoo. However, SCP-9051 can never be fully emptied.
When opened, SCP-9051 will also generate SCP-9051-A, an entity made out of same fluid inside SCP-9051 within a 3 meter spherical radius of its location. The entity is capable of emitting gurgling noises, but cannot move, speak

SCP-9052 refers to a week-long event of anomalous activity which took place at the gravesite of Zechariah Robinsons (PoI-9052-1). The gravestone of PoI-9052-1 will henceforth be referred to as SCP-9052-1. All anomalous activity at SCP-9052-1 took place over the time period of 1/22/201█ to 1/29/201█, periodically from 11:00 PM - 11:59 PM every day.


Gravestone of PoI-9052-1

SCP-9053 designates an anomalous phenomenon affecting mannequins, dolls, and other imitations of humanity. These mannequins will often be observed engaging in behavior that suggests sapience and locomotion, often in a manner that is considered uncanny and threatening. All observed events have later been determined to have entirely mundane explanations, however the frequency at which these events occur still warrant investigation.

SCP-9054 is an extradimensional anomaly located in New York City, New York. Before its sudden collapse, SCP-9054 was an infinitely large industrial complex with non-Euclidean2 internal geometry. SCP-9054 was previously only accessible via an access tunnel in the city's subway system, and only in the presence of SCP-9054-1, henceforth referred to as Sr. Researcher Nicholas Feynman.
Due to his unique interaction with SCP-9054, Feynman was assigned as the team lead for the project. It quickly becam
SCP-9055 is a large, complex, subterranean structure located directly below Site-14.

SCP-9056 is an amorphous mass fluctuating between 1 and 2 meters in height which levitates approximately 1.5 meters off the ground at all times. Its surface constantly displays an ever-changing array of images, the meaning of which is currently unknown. The object is sentient and capable of telepathic communication within a range of 5 meters.

SCP-9057 is a phenomenon that interferes in the perception of an individual's speech. It does not have an effect on non-verbal methods of communication. Anyone hearing this altered speech will perceive it as uninteresting in both content and delivery. Due to this perception being subjective, different individuals will perceive this speech in different ways. Individuals afflicted with SCP-9057 are not affected in this way, but suffer from other effects, including:

persistent, mild forgetfulness.

SCP-9058 is an adult male domestic cat; it weighs 4.9kg, has black fur, and is neutered. While SCP-9058 is apparently healthy and genetically and anatomically normal, it has not been observed to vocalize at all.
SCP-9059 is an event involving two human subjects, designated SCP-9059-FINDER and SCP-9059-SEEKER.

SCP-9060 odkazuje na virální kognitohazardní fenomén, který přiměje osobu (označenou SCP-9060-1) přejít do násilného stavu, když je jejich obličej pozorován jiným člověkem (označeným SCP-9060-2), ať už přímo, přes video záznam, fotografii, nebo platformu sociálních sítí.
SCP-9060-1 instance začnou vykazovat známky emocionální tísně, včetně brečení, křiku a nesrozumitelné mluvy, dokud stíhají SCP-9060-2. Subjekty se pohybují pouze přímočaře směrem k jejích cílům, bez ohledu na možné fyzické poško

SCP-9061 was a Charlie I class nuclear submarine, manufactured by the USSR at some point between 1967 and 1969. SCP-9061's hull was completely black, lacking any of the typical markings found on other vessels of the same class. SCP-9061 was capable of autonomous movement, as well as travelling at speeds and depths far greater than what its structure should have been capable of.
SCP-9061 would typically keep to depths between 800m and 1000m, making tracking difficult. However, it would occasional

SCP-9062 is a cube-like structure, hypothesised to exist in a higher dimensional plane than our own. Its standard size is 9 x 9 x 9 metres, though has been observed to shrink to as small as 2 x 2 x 2 millimetres, and expand as large as 30 x 30 x 30 metres. There is no known upper or lower limits to how much it can alter its size.
SCP-9062 is capable of off-ground levitation - most often suspending itself in-place in the air as it changes its size - though typically rests on the ground. The reaso

SCP-9063 is a series of abnormal fatalities occurring in and around the unincorporated community of Pemberton, Texas. As of Foundation recording, no cause for these fatalities has been established, nor have the conditions for such an anomaly to occur been identified. As of writing, the last SCP-9063 incident occurred on October 20, 2024.
The population of Pemberton has decreased to 26 as of the 2020 US census. Independent Foundation figures predict population figures further decreasing, and a se
SCP-9064 is Foundation-made antimemetic concept "UNDERKILL" (AM-68-1).

SCP-9065 is an ectoparasitic2 organism resembling a pair of light grey athleisure-style sweatpants3. The organism's exterior is similar in texture and appearance to a standard cotton/polyester material. The interior of the pants is similarly non-anomalous in appearance, and it is currently unknown how the organism keeps its teeth concealed when not feeding. Genetic testing has revealed similarities to Haemopis terrestris, also known as the American terrestrial leech. This, combined with the pres

SCP-9066 is a vivid near-human presence continuously felt by the entirety of the human population since its initial manifestation. SCP-9066 is not a physical object, entity, location, or phenomenon, it exists only as an intrinsic and universal human experience. It is always described as a nude, hairless, featureless, androgynous humanoid of average stature. Proper and unambiguous explanation of SCP-9066 to non-human life proved impossible. Despite superficial contradictions in related communicat

SCP-9067 denotes a weapon system utilizing ideometric contextual targeting and 4 dimensional non-Euclidean movement to deliver a payload. SCP-9067 is capable of targeting individuals based on a psychospheric signature consisting of 3 or more semantic markers. The current iteration has been modified for use in Foundation-manufactured SKYEYE, EVILEYE and BIG SKY series drones.
The ICT module entered development in 1963, before being shelved due to logistical and targeting precision concerns. These

SCP-9068 is the phenomenon of noospheric wildfires. Considered naturally occurring within the noosphere, these "wildfires" function to destroy and erase the debris that's been gathering dust in our collective heads. SCP-9068 is theorized to function akin to how baseline wildfires affect forests via fire ecology: when half-formed or fading concepts begin to build up within the noosphere and amalgam, these gatherings are marked as "dry," "cracked," "flammable." This calls the SCP-9068 phenomenon i

SCP-9070 was an explosion of thaumaturgic energy that originated from eastern Qeqqeta, Greenland at 11:23 UTC on the 26th of June, 2025. It expanded to an estimated radius of 200,000 to 350,000 kilometers from its point of origin and passed through most materials without resistance. It fully permeated through Earth at a point approximately 400-500 kilometers north of Concordia Station, Antarctica 1 minute and 32 seconds after its manifestation.
SCP-9070's main anomalous property was the disappea

SCP-9071 is a 21x27cm sheet of laminated printer paper, on which a picture of a cage of chicks is printed on one side. The opposite side is blank. When SCP-9071 is attached to a surface through any means, all sentient beings who view it become convinced that SCP-9071 is not a laminated sheet of printer paper, but rather an actual cage full of living chicks.
Viewers will react to SCP-9071 as though the associated stimuli are present, describing smells, sounds, movement, and the behaviors of the s

SCP-9072 refers to a humanoid entity that has the appearance of a male human's shadow. From observations, the entity is believed to be 1.7 m (67 inches) tall, and locomotion occurs via silent levitation. Attempts at identifying the entity through thermal camera footage have failed, as the entity appears to emit no body heat.
The entity manifests between 11:00 PM and 6:30 AM local time, on all days of the year aside from the 10th of October. During manifestations, SCP-9072's movement patterns hav

When an individual enters SCP-9074 and closes its doors, they disappear for a period ranging from 1 to 15 minutes. Upon exiting, subjects exhibit a physical or symbolic manifestation of a deeply concealed aspect of their identity

SCP-9075 is the collective designation for the various ongoing phenomena affecting Postojna, Slovenia and its residents in the years since the 2077 Kresnik Chemical Plant Disaster. These phenomena center around the potential contamination of the town’s water supply and are believed to originate from one of the locations most severely impacted by the chemical plant’s total destruction — the depths of Postojna Cave.

Once the phenomena becomes active, the mahjong tile set in use will be spontaneously modified to accommodate the new rulings. All players become immediately aware of all rule changes, without the need of further clarification.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9078 is a common raven1 partially domesticated as part of a bird training program run in the city of Swansea, Wales. During this program, SCP-9078 was given the pet name "basketball"[sic] by its handlers.

SCP-9079 is a large language model-based consumer A.I. chatbot created by MithTech, a Silicon Valley tech startup founded in 2019 by C.E.O. Milo November.1 SCP-9079 functions similarly to non-anomalous A.I. tools like ChatGPT or Google Gemini in that users input text-based prompts and SCP-9079 uses a predictive algorithm to generate responses.
When individuals read responses generated by SCP-9079, they will immediately believe that any information presented by SCP-9079 is factual. When asked to

SCP-9080 is the collective designation for a continuous series of handwritten letters that arrive without postmarks, stamps, or return addresses.1 Letters are uniformly written with blue ballpoint ink on lined paper and wrapped in envelopes made of construction paper.
To date, no discernible pattern has been found across recipients, as instances have been delivered worldwide to civilians across a wide range of demographics with no apparent connection to one another. However, each recipient has o

SCP-9081 is the designation for a series of cigarette packets created and distributed by GoI-006 ("The Factory") through anomalous means. Packets of SCP-9081 manifest spontaneously on shelves alongside standard tobacco products in retail locations worldwide. Analysis of the cigarettes has revealed nothing substantial, as they are largely identical to their non-anomalous counterparts.
The properties of SCP-9081 manifest when all the cigarettes in a given packet are consumed by a single individual

Discovered in 2002. Origin is as of yet unknown. SCP-9082 is a website accessible at the domain 'www.redroom.live' which hosts numerous live-streams and text-based forums. Said live-streams consist entirely of static shots of interiors; examples include basements, classrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, church halls, and bedrooms. It has been determined that affected individuals possess no knowledge of one another. The following is a minute-by-minute reconstruction of the events of the false memory.

SCP-9084 is the designation for a fact that does not exist, is not true, and concerns an event that did not happen.

SCP-9085 is an infection of unknown origin with the ability to spread via an extensive list of methods. It is currently unknown whether SCP-9085 is viral, bacterial, or fungal in nature. While exposure is the most common means by which an individual will become infected with SCP-9085, a smaller yet statistically significant proportion of sufferers are born with it.

SCP-9086 appears to be an Intel Paragon supercomputer that has fallen into disrepair, resembling systems produced by Intel in the 1990s. SCP-9086 was acquired during a foundation raid on an abandoned building located near Cambridge, Massachusetts, following the spread of rumors regarding the existence of a previously undocumented supercomputer on deep web forums. SCP-9087 manifests as street art depicting a humanoid-animal hybrid with irisless, pupilless eyes and an open mouth. SCP-9087 is capable of manifesting upon any exterior surface in metropolitan areas across the world. SCP-9087 is chemically identical to aerosol paint, being easily erased by standard removal methods.
Upon making visual contact with SCP-9087, any individual who has previously suffered a second-trimester miscarriage or stillbirth will be compelled to submerge themself in an open bo

SCP-9088 is a room located within Site-19 on an abandoned sublevel. The room measures 2 x 4 x 3 meters. It is made of concrete, and the walls are painted a light beige. Despite a lack of routine maintenance, the room is mostly free of dust, mold, and contaminants.
No red objects can be inside or within the bounds of the SCP-9088 room. This is an intrinsic property of the area that has so far tested to be inviolable. It is currently unclear as to how or why SCP-9088 cannot have red objects in it,
The alleyway is an alleyway with a heavily restricted set of facts attributable to it with which it can be described.
SCP-9090 is an organic humanoid standing at 1.98 meters and weighing 67.8 kilograms. It displays limited motor control, but is believed to be sentient and aware of its surroundings.

SCP-9091 designates an anomalous device resembling both a coarse rope noose and a mechanosynthetic quantum computer with antimatter-production capabilities. SCP-9091 is believed to originate at least 14 billion light years away from the solar system and was discovered in Jerusalem on 02/14/2023 during a routine archaeological dig. Its purpose is unknown. A number of triggers have caused SCP-9091 activity in a variety of forms, typically associated with a deleterious effect on local reality, topo
SCP-9092 is an ornamental snow globe that measures 2.8m in diameter. Its pedestal and casing are made of ordinary marble and glass.

SCP-9093 refers to Righteous Justice, a crime fiction television program that airs exclusively within the Greater Utica Area. At any time, it may manifest itself and commandeer an existing broadcasting station, after which the station will only air SCP-9093. If SCP-9093 is not removed from a commandeered broadcast station for over three hours, it will manifest on local streaming services, making removal significantly more difficult.
SCP-9093’s source is impossible to geolocate, and may only be r

SCP-9094 refers to a social media website known as “Petafox.com”. SCP-9094 is hidden from the general public and is only accessible by sapient artificial intelligences. While a Foundation web sweep was able to discover the website, all that is accessible to those who do not fit the criteria is a picture depicting the avatar of the website’s founder, a sapient artificial intelligence known as Vixen (dubbed SCP-9094-1), alongside options prompting the user to either 'sign in' or 'create an account

SCP-9095 is an anomalous website, titled "Victims of VKTM Memorial Foundation", presumably originating from and maintained by Vikander-Kneed Technical Media (GOI-5889). SCP-9095 can be taken offline with no unusual difficulty, but, since its discovery, a new iteration has reliably been identified within 5-10 days of removal. No infohazardous properties have been observed, but there is evidence that accessing the site may cause an individual to become more open to suggestion, more trusting of the

SCP-9096 is a phenomenon where food left in the Site-96 break room disappears

when unobserved. Food left unobserved in this way disappears inconsistently, with no currently known pattern. The type of food also seems to affect the chance of disappearance, as sugary or meaty foods disappear much more often, and soybean-based foods appear to be unaffected.
The phenomenon was first detected on 08/08/25 following complaints by several Site-96 staff members of missing lunches, and has continued since
SCP-9097 refers to a collection of circular pills of bright pink coloring. SCP-9097 has no label, but the back holds a logo for GOI-4319 "Just Girly Things".
SCP-9098 was an anomalous sentient broadcast signal that was neutralized on 11/12/1996 by SCP-9098-B

SCP-9099 is a concrete silo approximately seventy-five meters in diameter and two hundred and twenty-five meters in height, located approximately seventy kilometers northeast of ████████, Siberia. Though it came under Foundation control after the fall of the Soviet Union, it is not known if it was originally created by the Soviets, as all pertinent GRU-P records were destroyed prior to their dissolution.
Though its brutalist style is consistent with mid-20th-century Soviet architecture, dating m

SCP-9100 is an anomaly speculated to account for rapid mental health decline in a subset of the Akron, OH population immediately following the 2014 Akron mid-air disaster. Affected individuals, primarily senior citizens, become convinced they have "skipped" several decades of their life, with no memory of the intervening years.

The duration of missing time varies between subjects, averaging 35 years.
The whereabouts of every subject during the relevant time periods are accounted for.

SCP-9101 is Edmund Watts, a 52-year-old repairman who is apparently incapable of remaining within any dynamic for an extended period of time. This effect extends to specific locations, relationships, and states of being. While SCP-9101 is capable of using its ability directly, the effect may also manifest when SCP-9101 is unconscious, distracted, or otherwise unable to provide direct input.1

SCP-9104 is a fissure in the ground at Site-109's main warehouse, approximately 0.93m in size. It does not pose any threat to base-level normalcy or living organisms, nor does it expand in size. It is unambiguously a regular crack in the floor, constituting no danger at all, that maintenance at the Site has delayed fixing (due to plain indolence).
It has been designated an anomaly in this file solely to expedite processes to repair it, as well as to hasten explanation to any Foundation employee

SCP-9106 is the collective designation given to the Eisenfremder Real Estate company and the anomalous phenomenon employed by or otherwise associated with it. SCP-9106 operates similarly to a non-anomalous real estate company, but specifically targets anomalous properties, structures and locations for the purposes of acquiring, refurbishing and selling them. It is noted that SCP-9106 exclusively targets locations featuring artificial or manufactured structures.

It was not illusory.

SCP-9108 is a graveyard in the village of Dois Rios,1 Portugal. The village was decimated by a natural disaster in the year 1941 and has been abandoned ever since. Persons entering the graveyard will collapse and fall unconscious. While unconscious, affected persons will experience anomalous dreams, classified as SCP-9108-1 instances. SCP-9109 refers to a phenomenon wherein physical objects, living organisms, and eventually entire celestial bodies undergo transmutation into ‘holes’ in the fabric of reality. Instances of SCP-9109 have no tactile influence of any forces around it (such as gravity or air). Though, instances may be entered leading to the participating entity exiting the Universe, resulting in its destruction.
The phenomenon was first observed on 03/06/██25, when Dr. Hart failed to report for a scheduled ethics re

SCP-9110 is the sudden disappearance of David Thompson (POI-9110), which occurred on 03/05/2025.
The unusual circumstances surrounding the event prompted a joint investigation by the UIU and FIIC,1 and resulted in the subsequent classification as an anomaly. A full timeline and an overview of the investigation has been included in this file.2

SCP-9112 is an adult female Pinacosaurus grangeri.2 It experiences negligible senescence, if at all, and demonstrates extreme regenerative abilities. Testing of these abilities are not considered a necessary function of the Foundation, and as such have been indefinitely halted per General Order 05-LIMITATION-Q2.

Although additions and subtractions are possible, any element conflicting with the initial intent cannot be artistically expressed.

SCP-9114 is an animate 15th-century suit of plated armour, approximately 1.75 m in height. Its construction and ornamentation match armaments from midland regions of the Holy Roman Empire. Despite lacking a gambeson or internal framework, all components remain suspended and articulate as though worn by a human body. Individual plates can be removed but autonomously return to their correct positions once released.

SCP-9115 is the collective designation for an unknown quantity of visually indistinct stones. Despite no evident memetic, compulsory, or mind-altering anomalous properties, SCP-9115 instances have been utilized in an unusually high quantity of violent incidents, in particular violent incidents affecting minors in the contiguous United States.

SCP-9117 is a small ceramic teapot with various engravings upon its surface. When static, these engravings resemble 15th century Arabic calligraphy, although the characters do not correspond to any known extinct or modern language. The teapot is worn, and has several cracks around its rim which prevents a lid from being placed on it.

SCP-9118 is a thaumaturgically active contractual document. It is written on vellum in a combination of standard Italian and a partially deciphered thaumaturgic notation derived from an Etruscan-adjacent script. The document bears two signatures. The first has been confirmed by forensic analysis as belonging to Enzo Anselmo Ferrari (1898-1988).
