SCP-9119 is an anomalous population of Formica polyctena, colloquially known as wood ants. Members of SCP-9119 display atypical behavior where various processes of the colony are used in unproductive or actively detrimental ways. This includes the creation of unnecessary rooms within the colony, the storage of small amounts of food, eggs, and detritus within those rooms, and hyper-aggression toward ants not part of SCP-9119.

SCP-9121 was an astronomical event that occurred above the town of Beddington, Maine, on April 6, 2025. The event itself was an unnatural solar eclipse that lasted approximately an hour and a half. During this eclipse, entities hereon referred to as SCP-9121-1 were made visible.

SCP-9122 is a looped radio signal operating in the high-frequency range, observed at ██GHz, an encrypted channel formerly reserved for Foundation operations only. How SCP-9122 accessed the channel is currently unknown. SCP-9122 is extrasolar1 in origin, with its exact broadcast location unknown. The transmission itself consists of dialogue in an unintelligible alien language lasting exactly four minutes and thirty-two seconds in length. Translation efforts are currently underway, but have faced

SCP-9123 refers to a humanoid entity previously described by the Foundation as PoI-99123, a.k.a “Dorian Cillian Sloan”. Its primary anomalous ability is producing verbal commands capable of compelling sapient subjects to perform actions against their own wills. The precise mechanisms of this effect are unknown, except that it exhibits an unusually potent strength against individuals with high CRVs.3 Because of this, it is theorized that the determinant of SCP-9123’s compulsive strength instead r

SCP-9124 is a shared condition wherein blood is able to pass between victims. It is known to afflict seven women, four of which have been identified conclusively. Despite the lack of physical connection between the victims, substances injected into one will appear in the bloodstream of the others some time later, ranging from minutes to weeks, and the heartbeats of each victim can be faintly detected in the others. New victims can be conclusively identified by the presence of the DNA of known vi
SCP-9125 is the root of human unreason.
SCP-9126 is an anomalous subspecies of the ichneumon wasp Podogaster Cactorum. SCP-9126 instances appear identical to their non-anomalous counterparts, and behave mostly identically as well.

SCP-9127 is a 75 cm long bansuri2 made out of a single long shaft of bamboo, featuring six holes for playing. The embouchure is made of ivory and has been tied with a thin thread to prevent cracking. SCP-9127 is adorned with jewels, which display no anomalous effects. Reports have shown that the flute demonstrates immense thaumaturgical abilities, only activating in the presence of a flutist who is learned in Indian classical music and ragas.3 The thaumaturgical abilities aforementioned include

SCP-9128 is a book titled the book of all things by dado. Despite its size, SCP-9128 has an infinite number of pages. SCP-9128 is a dictionary containing all possible combinations of letters and their definitions.

SCP-9129 is an abnormally large humanoid skeleton discovered in the Sakai Scrub Natural Area. It is interred upright, with its upper half exposed. Before containment, the remains were overgrown with crossvine. The ribcage has been distended by a massive, empty wasp's nest. Layered white stains under the orbital and nasal cavities are attributed to bird feces. The bones remain connected in the absence of ligaments. The flesh has entirely decayed.
Approaching SCP-9129 with the intent to touch it r

SCP-9130 is an effect that transforms members of the Coniferous and Deciduous2 groups of trees into SCP-9130-1 instances. 9130-1 instances have an increased metabolism and growth rate, which appear at first to be ectoentropic in nature, but actually drains from the surrounding reality for nutrition. SCP-9130-1 instances measurably have a lower Hume reading than baseline, indicating that they are acting as a constant reality sink. It is currently unknown how SCP-9130-1 instances convert reality t

SCP-9131 is the collective designation for an unknown number of objects possessing enclosed spaces. Extensive testing has revealed that the material composition of SCP-9131 instances can only be altered from matter inside the instance.

SCP-9132 is a small hardbound book of an indeterminate number of pages. No title or similarly recognizable clues to signify an author or origin are present with its cover otherwise depicting an encircled hexagram through iron rivets. The leather used in SCP-9132's binding is composed from several disparate animal sources, including Bos taurus, Equus ferus caballus, Capra hircus, Homo sapiens, and Panthera leo1. Attempts to measure the exact number of SCP-9132's pages prove ineffectual due to SCP
SCP-9133 is a beach ball, possessing a low density. Despite this, the object is negatively buoyant.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9135 is a highly organized cloud with a rain-free base, wall cloud, and anvil top. It should be noted that SCP-9135 is currently intensifying into a supercell thunderstorm.

SCP-9136 is a wheelchair that is able to move autonomously, requiring no maintenance, and which can manifest small quantities of alcohol, cigarettes, or other illicit substances in its folds and pockets. It has a high degree of situational awareness regarding its surroundings and immediate context, using that information to navigate itself towards individuals using mobility devices.
SCP-9136 will roll itself to urban areas with a high population density, positioning itself in impoverished areas

SCP-9137 proper refers to a river that suddenly appeared within the ████████ region of ██████2. The appearance of the river has led to water from the anomalous zone contaminating the groundwater in use by the nearby town of ██████3.

SCP-9138 is the newly dominant moral framework of the universe as of 25/06/1950. It selects sapient souls considered exceptional by their peers, distinguishing them primarily by their tomb decorations and grave-goods. Souls so recognised by their community are sorted into a variety of paradisiacal afterlives which reflect their actions while living. These afterlives embody SCP-9138-A’s ethical and aesthetic values, and are structured to reward and further perpetuate such behaviour.
SCP-9138-A ar

SCP-9139 is Foundation Team Lead Malkinder Singh Chattha, age 26, who experiences a constant state of disequilibrium unaffected by medications and therapy. Extensive imagery, both anomalous and nonanomalous, has displayed no expected internal physiological explanation. Instead, SCP-9139 exerts an uncontrollable, mild reality-bending effect on itself that perpetually affects its sense of balance.

SCP-9140 is a set of Daevite ritual objects, referred to in translated primary sources as the Imperial Bloodsieve. Its principal component (designated SCP-9140-1) is a carved stone statue, measuring 12.5cm in height. The statue resembles the figure of a pregnant woman, with glyphs carved around its circumference. Above the carvings, there is a groove carved into the stone, measuring 0.7cm in width and 0.5cm in depth.







An artistic representation of SCP-9140.

SCP-9141 is an umbrella term referring to all minor curses placed onto the Foundation. There are currently 37 active curses and 8957 in the history of SCP-9141’s written record.2

SCP-9142 is a collective designation for a colony of four sapient rodents capable of producing an HUME-Degradation pheromone.1 This anomalous pheromone only manifests following the consumption of Mentha cunninghamii2 leaves. SCP-9142 will produce their HUME-Degradation pheromone for approximately two hours following activation, after which no anomalous traits can be observed. Though sapient, SCP-9142 are not able to communicate verbally and instead portray their thoughts through actions and gest
SCP-9143, also known as Lake Love, is a lake in Tennessee measured to be 6400m², located in the south-eastern region of the rural mining town "██████."

SCP-9144 is a chemically unidentified viscous liquid with similar properties to oil. It generally appears red in colour. The item's main anomalous property is the capability to smooth human skin to anomalous extents with contact.1 This effect is progressive with contact, and It is unknown if there is a limit to which the fluids properties will scale to, for more information see Test Log A3/9144, attached below in this document.
SCP-9144 was originally found by the orthotan archeologist hive mind

SCP-9145 is a 16-count pack of colored crayons. Exact colors included vary between instances; so far, one hundred and two (102) colors have been documented. Individual SCP-9145 crayons are to be referred to as SCP-9145-01 through -102, as defined in Appendix A.
The properties of SCP-9145 only take effect when it is utilized by a subject between the ages of 4 and 11 years old. Drawings made using SCP-9145 will typically manifest as entities designated SCP-9145-A.
Instances of SCP-9145-A are senti

SCP-9146 is an anomalous phenomenon centered on an individual designated SCP-9146-1, who identifies himself as Gerald Pottsman, a census officer employed by the Ministry of Population Accounting of the Republic of Tevodria. No sovereign nation, administrative territory, or historical polity by this name has been identified in any known record.
SCP-9146-1 presents as a Caucasian male, approximately 55 years of age, 175 cm in height, of medium build. He has been observed wearing a brown two-piece

SCP-9147 is a species of humanoids that appear indistinguishable from humans. All examined instances of SCP-9147 exhibit specialized digestive tracts and are incapable of ingesting anything other than human flesh. Any deviations in diet have resulted in severe nausea, vomiting, and involuntary muscle spasms.
Instances have demonstrated physical capabilities substantially beyond human norms, including enhanced muscular strength, reaction speed, sensory acuity, and regenerative abilities. Some sub

SCP-9148 is a prototype paraweapon developed in the 1970s by the Soviet Union's Main Intelligence Directorate, Psychotronics Division (GRU-P) for use in assassinations. The device superficially resembles a pistol, but kills through the use of psychokinetic force, rather than projectiles.
The core of SCP-9148 is a cylinder of an unknown metal alloy, similar in composition to the "telekill" alloy developed by Prometheus Labs. This cylinder is encased in beryllium-bronze. Approximately one meter of

SCP-9149 is a virus of unknown composition, the structure of which appears snowflake-shaped when viewed under a microscope. Subjects infected with SCP-9149 become obsessed with celebrating the Christmas holiday and will alter their behavior and routines to center completely around activities associated with Christmas, even if they do not celebrate the holiday or possess Christian beliefs.
SCP-9149 is spread through contact with infected bodily fluids, SCP-9149 is primarily concentrated in the sa
SCP-9150 refers to an anomaly that is present in the mind of every living Homo sapiens.

SCP-9151-A is an orange tree that grows half oranges instead of full oranges. Every instance of the fruit, henceforth referred to as SCP-9151-B, possesses an anomalous property that moves it autonomously, pushing it to combine with another SCP-9151-B instance from the same crop. This process is known as SCP-9151-C and it lasts anywhere from a second to an hour. Afterwards, the two SCP-9151-B instances become indistinguishable from a non-anomalous orange.
SCP-9151-A was found in a field in Valenc

SCP-9152 is a deific entity embodying the concept of villainy, antagonism, and socially unacceptable behaviour - i.e., a god of villains. For unknown reasons, the entity is only able to manifest on Earth once per year on September 24th. Manifestations are typically fairly brief, with the longest recorded manifestation lasting for 7 minutes. The entity's physical appearance is that of a humanoid figure wearing a spandex costume complete with cape and face-concealing mask. The costume is yellow wi

SCP-9153 is the hypothetical solution to the continuum hypothesis2: an open problem in mathematics surrounding the possible sizes of infinite sets. In set theory, rather than a singular label for the cardinality (size) of an infinite set, it is understood that there exists an endless sequence of infinite cardinalities, each one bigger than the last. The continuum hypothesis then posits that there is no infinite cardinality that lies between that of the integers, which are the first infinity in t

SCP-9154 is an anomalous species of coral phenotypically identical to the staghorn coral (Acropora cervicornis). SCP-9154 differs from non-anomalous staghorn corals in several ways:

SCP-9154 instances are able to expand each day by an amount equivalent to fifty years of growth in non-anomalous staghorn corals.


The planulae2 of SCP-9154 are capable of locomotion at velocities of up to 9 m/s3. They display a strong preference for attaching to stationary metallic, ceramic, and plastic surfaces.

SCP-9155 is a fluid of extraterrestrial origin collected after Incident 9155-D, in which the substance was scattered across the southern United States as a form of precipitation (see Addendum 1). This fluid is the excretion of a serpentine celestial entity, seemingly analogous to urine. It is believed that its anomalous properties are related to a life- or hibernation-supporting process within the entity (see Addendum 8). It is a shimmery blue that glows slightly in daylight, though this glow ha

Discovered in 2026 from an occult manuscript in the Foundation archives. SCP-9156 is a phrase or incantation which instantaneously transmutates all forms of plant life botanically designated as “trees” into mounds of various insects native to the country. Chiefly these mounds will be insect species, but instances of chelicerates, myriapods, crustaceans, as well as molluscs have been recorded. Mounds will take the rough shape of the targeted tree before collapsing as the insects become animate. T

SCP-9157 is a thaumaturgical barrier concealing the existence of Homo sapiens sidhe (commonly designated "faeries"). It encompasses the forest area of Reelig Glen, located in the Scottish Highlands. The existence of instances of SCP-9157 located in other parts of the world is currently unknown.
SCP-9157 is invisible, immaterial, and imperceptible to human beings. Post-neutralization studies have revealed its invisibility to partially malfunction when SCP-9157 is fragmented or receding. The thaum

SCP-9158 is an English-language livestreaming platform and anonymous imageboard website hosted on the domain www.████████.net. The site hosts a small number of boards dedicated to topics surrounding health, medicine, science, and chemistry, with a primary focus of its users (designated SCP-9158-1) being neuroscience. SCP-9158-1 are uniformly anonymous posters with no concrete pointers as to their identities; on average, SCP-9158-1 type using American spelling and grammatical conventions, and occ

SCP-9159 is a worldwide phenomenon that causes animal remains to undergo significant anomalous mutations, turning into fully formed SCP-9159-1 instances over the course of 11 hours, after which they will experience a REVELATION event if the cause of their death fits the following criteria:

The animal is a vertebrate of the kingdom Animalia
The animal is non-anomalous
██ ████ ████ ███ ███████
The animal's death could have been prevented
The animal does not belong to the following species:

Homo
SCP-9160 designates a paranormal event that occurs every Monday at 1700 hours within a cave in the outskirts of Branson, Missouri.

SCP-9161 is a line of women’s shoes by designer Marcelo Brunelleschi manufactured between 1982 and 1986. When a pair of SCP-9161 are worn, a neurological link between the shoes and the wearer is formed so that any damage to the shoe manifests as a temporary lesion of the brain at a topographically corresponding site. When the shoes are removed, the wearer regains all mental and neurological faculties.
All contained SCP-9161 instances were seized together from a leather deadstock warehouse; suppl

SCP-9162 (Aedilis falsis) is a species of large terrestrial insectoid, differentiated from non-anomalous megafauna by their highly specialized camouflage traits, which enable instances of SCP-9162 to adapt seamlessly to a wide variety of ecological niches shortly after hatching.
Due to this high degree of physiological diversity, identifying SCP-9162's common traits has proven difficult, as has identifying A. falsis nearest non-anomalous relatives. In testing, instances of SCP-9162 which are dir
SCP-9163 is the name given to a phenomenon reported on social media on the morning of 01/14/26 in [REDACTED], a town in the province of Perugia, Italy.

SCP-9165 is a tall, humanoid entity approximately 1.9 meters tall, referred to as "Indrid Cold." The entity is dressed formally, wearing a suit or coat and pants made of the same unknown material. The entity is known to teleport and appear in multiple locations at once. SCP-9165 is described by exposed personnel to be visually intimidating even when viewed from a distance. SCP-9165 is known to communicate through telepathy.
SCP-9165 was first discovered in 1953 when William Hill reported a "Smil

SCP-9166 is an email received by each member of the O5 Council simultaneously via SCiPNET at 2:34pm EST on 7/3/2026. The body of the email reads "I know what you are. You will pay for your crimes, each of you." Attached to the email is a diagram, showing the exact location of Site-01.
SCP-9167 is a phenomenon that causes anomalous mental and physical changes in dentists. 75-100 cases are reported yearly worldwide with no discernible pattern.

SCP-9168 is a previously undocumented insect species designated Mutoscutum variabile by Foundation taxonomists. Specimens measure between 12 and 18mm in length and are morphologically near-identical to Sphaerocoris annulus (Fabricius, 1775), the Picasso Bug, a species of shield-backed bug belonging to the family Scutelleridae, order Hemiptera. Like S. annulus, SCP-9168 exhibits a prominent, dome-shaped thoracic scutellum and a similarly stocky build, which causes it to be frequently mistaken for

Formerly containment chamber #9169. Standard Euclid-class anomaly holding cell; reinforced concrete walls and lead-lined heavy-duty steel door. Recently recovered files seem to imply some kind of structural modification was made to the chamber prior to its current state.
Chamber is hypothesised to emit a strong antimemetic effect. All information regarding the contents of the chamber's interior can not be retained in any way, either through memory or writing. Individuals that look into the chamb

SCP-9170 is a two story, Craftsman-style house built in the 1920s, located in the South West of England. Local maps and signage are consistent in the address being recorded as No. 17 Gorse Avenue. The other 34 houses on Gorse Avenue are similar in style and further details have been omitted from this report due to their non-anomalous nature. They are currently used to house staff, and to store equipment and supplies.
SCP-9170 appears to have no anomalous preservation properties and requires stan

SCP-9171 is a 2km wide geyser located on continental Europe that erupted outside Paris, France, on 1 March 2026. SCP-9171 is connected to the Atlantic Ocean via an unknown number of underground tributary channels that act similarly in principle to a root system, which feed a reservoir chamber within the earth's crust wherein pressure builds until eventual eruption. The column of water projected from SCP-9171 is capable of reaching the highest section of the troposphere, where the water is instan

SCP-9172 is an anomaly affecting children attending Westwood Grove Playschool in Westwood Grove, South Dakota. Adults over the age of 18 have not been found to be affected by SCP-9172. The anomaly affects children who enter Westwood Grove Playschool permanently, and no effective cure has been found as of writing.
SCP-9172 causes sporadic and inappropriate behavior in affected children. Common traits of affectation are abnormal mental faculties, depressive and hostile attitudes, and general disob

SCP-9173 is a solid granite statue carved in the likeness of former O5-█, [REDACTED]. It is located in ███████████, Galveston City, Texas, USA, and was first unveiled on 4 July 1857, in commemoration of [REDACTED]'s role in the American Revolution. SCP-9173 measures 3.5 meters tall, with a pedestal measuring 0.6 meters on each side. To date, all attempts to damage SCP-9173 for the purpose of collecting samples have failed, presumably due to the influence of SCP-9173-A.
SCP-9173's primary anomalo

SCP-9174 was created in 1970 by the Beatles and Jerry Lee Lewis, and was released by Memphis Sun Studios as a 5,000-piece remix record of "Here Comes The Sun" and "Great Balls of Fire". Subsequent interviews with relevant individuals revealed that none of them had any memory of creating or releasing this record.
When subject is played, regardless of where the pointer or the record is located, it will always start playing from the 0:00:00 mark of the music, and during the playback process, there

SCP-9175 is an optical phenomenon of unknown nature that was visible exclusively from within the township of Lakeridge, Montana2 between 12:00 and 1:00 am on June 23rd of 2015. Unmagnified photographs and witness accounts of the phenomenon describe an exceptionally bright, abnormally slow meteor, which originated over Andromeda and proceeded south, crossing the entire night sky until it passed the horizon. No magnified photographs of the phenomenon are believed to exist. It is not believed that

SCP-9176 was a 2,834-acre ranch outside the town of Hondo, TX, owned and inhabited by Eric Bauer (aged 86), who exhibited no paranormal properties. SCP-9176 was discovered by Agent R. Kowalska during a survey expedition for an unrelated investigation. His handwritten notes and drawings of the property were found to be unaffected by its paranormal effect. Bauer claimed the land had been inherited from his parents, who had likewise inherited it from previous generations.
Beginning in 1986, portion

SCP-9177 refers to a collection of 7 deceased European honey bees (Apis mellifera). Despite the deceased nature of SCP-9177 instances, no decomposition has occurred in any of the specimens for the entire span of its containment.

SCP-9178 is the Arlington International Racetrack, currently visually indistinguishable from its original appearance prior to July 31st, 1985. SCP-9178 exists entirely within a pocket of space that overlaps with its historical counterpart, but is largely inaccessible for most of the year. Foundation spatial penetration technology is able to override this if required. SCP-9178 access is restored during time periods in which the location would have been open to the public and hosting a derby — pri

SCP-9181 is the uninhabited area of Lowri Island off of the coast of Scotland. Lowri Island itself has remained uninhabited since discovery due to the anomalous effects it demonstrates as well as the newly anomalous local wildlife.

SCP-9182 is a combat-active Mobile Task Force, designated Sigma-16 ("Honed Edges"), currently in service with the Foundation. Prior to its exposure to an unknown anomalous object, and subsequent SCP classification, SCP-9182 held the designation of Platoon Charlie, MTF Epsilon-6 ("Village Idiots").
Individual members of SCP-9182 are designated SCP-9182-1 through SCP-9182-12. Should any instance of SCP-9182-X expire, their physical location and condition is reverted to that of precisely 34 minutes

SCP-9183 is an anomalous increase in unsafe and unhealthy social behaviour and the health conditions which follow from them. These increases are extremely localized and are attributed to SCP-9183-1 visiting nightlife locations in the day(s) prior to their onset. Behaviours affected by SCP-9183 have included, but are not thought to be limited to:

Smoking of tobacco and electronic nicotine products, followed by pneumonia, blood clots, and possibly various types of cardiovascular disease and cance

SCP-9184 designates a trans-temporal entity inhabiting the human noosphere referred to colloquially as "The God of Empathy". Encounters with SCP-9184 both in and outside of the human Dreamscape have shown it to be both sustained by as well as capable of amplifying collective human compassion, mourning, and aspiration. Unlike most deities, SCP-9184 is unable to manifest willingly, although it can be summoned by acts or gestures from humans falling within its domain. These invocations do not seem

SCP-9185 is an entity composed entirely of sound waves. It is capable of travelling through all forms of matter and moves through air at Mach 1 velocity. It perceive its surroundings through some form of echolocation. The entity has the ability to reproduce any sound known to it with perfect accuracy, including human speech. The range of frequencies it has been observed to produce is from 10mHz to 300MHz, but its actual range could be beyond that.
SCP-9185 is fully sentient and has shown remarka

SCP-9186 was a 95-carat diamond, originally mined in Andhra Pradesh, India, sometime in the early 1400s. Records indicate that if the local light level was sufficiently dark, SCP-9186 emitted a 15-lumen glow, similar to a children's nightlight. It was used by a series of monarchs within South Asia as a reading aid or for vision at night.
SCP-9186 was acquired through initial exploits in the region, which concluded with the suspension of British activities in South Asia. Popular rumors during thi

SCP-9187 is a Soviet pedestal-style desk lamp, visually similar to production units manufactured by ZiK in 1981. The object features a base made of glazed ceramic supporting a metal lamp assembly with a decoratively perforated cylindrical housing. It is topped with a wide, ribbed glass diffuser, which does not appear to be part of the original set.
The lamp shows moderate wear including mild surface abrasion, discoloration, and heat-related patina on metallic components, suggesting that the lamp
SCP-9188 is a cybernetically augmented great white shark (Carcharodon carcharias), which is approximately 6.5 meters in length.

SCP-9189 is a cinnamon bear (Ursus americanus cinnamomum) whose body extends horizontally at a consistent rate. SCP-9189 is wider than its containment cell at all times. Despite this, SCP-9189 is fully contained within the cell. The mechanism by which this occurs is not currently understood. Investigation is ongoing.
SCP-9189's anomalous width and expansion do not affect its typical biological functions. All of its internal biological processes operate within standard parameters for a specimen o

SCP-9190 is a form of surgery capable of transferring a human subject into the future.4 Personnel sent into the future by SCP-9190 are unable to call back or return to the past; this process is typically used to enforce the presence of the Foundation within periods of time that would otherwise lead to the Foundation ceasing to exist.

Representation of SCP-9193 from SCPCAD, showing SCP-9193-A and its base. The maroon paint is displayed where it is below the water line.


The exterior appears to have no major structural or design differences from a standard VKM-3M excluding a recent, haphazardly applied coat of maroon paint on the hull that extends from the top

SCP-9194 is the randomly appearing clause "And Patterson too" in existing English-based print, visual, and audio-based media. Its presence itself is unremarkable and non-anomalous; no characters will comment on SCP-9194, and no viewers or listeners report adverse effects. Consumers, however, do notice SCP-9194.
When in written form, the punctuation and grammar of SCP-9194 will be linguistically sound.1 However, the specific punctuation itself may change between manifestations. SCP-9194 appearanc

SCP-9195 is a phenomenon causing the disappearance of lost items and people. Current testing shows it to occur to objects in which an individual has an emotional attachment, with the nature of the emotional attachment having no effect on the chances of an SCP-9195 manifestation. Additionally, SCP-9195 impairs the memory of individuals who have formed an attachment to affected items, preventing them from clearly recalling the objects.
Items confirmed to have been affected by SCP-9195 through arch

SCP-9196-A is the unconscious body of a male human of eastern Asian ethnicity, roughly 1.8 meters tall and weighing 82 kilograms. Subject's age is estimated to be between 27 and 30 years. Neural analysis shows fully functional cognitive abilities.

SCP-9197 is an illness with a memetic effect that inflicts strong urges of suicide on any of its patients(dubbed SCP-9197-A), as well as the urge to be seen doing so. SCP-9197 spreads if someone sees the death of an SCP-9197-A instance, both self-inflicted or by another individual. The illness can be first detected mere minutes after infection, however, it only takes full effect around 24 hours following initial exposure. SCP-9197 starts by inflicting depression on its host, eventually escalatin

SCP-9198 refers to a hostile, hivemind-like organism that visually mimics the appearance of snow. Its diet primarily consists of siphoning any nearby sources of thermal energy and organic matter, which it utilizes to replicate on a massive scale. Despite its potential to trigger an NK-Class (“Grey Goo”) Scenario, SCP-9198 is currently contained within the confines of Montreal Island in Canada, effectively preventing a global catastrophe.
A direct consequence of SCP-9198’s sustained presence on t

data.descriptionExcerpt: URA-7DL is a bipedal chimerical entity, origin unknown, estimated to be two meters in height. It is composed of bodily features from a ram, tortoise, baboon, crab, scorpion, ox, and snakes. URA-7DL is capable of emitting sarin gas, and has been reported to flay and devour children, using their skin as clothing. Prior to Foundation discovery, it had been sighted seven kilometers southwest of ████████, but its current whereabouts are unknown.

SCP-9200 is a crashed spacefaring5 vessel located in Makronisos, Greece. SCP-9200's operating artificial intelligence (known hereafter as SCP-9200-A) is functioning and has been since the ship first crashed into the island over 3000 years ago. The vessel has suffered catastrophic damage to its hull and major systems. The vessel is still capable of movement, and has burrowed into the central island's ridge.6 The SCP Foundation maintains limited control of the affected area through agreements with

SCP-9201 is the Foundation Reality Transaction Manager (FRTM), a piece of paratechnology which enables ACID transaction processing on a piece of local reality. Due to its immense power requirements and the difficulty of properly determining conceptual parameters, effective use for Foundation operations is challenging.
The primary use of the FRTM is in SCP-9201-A, the Foundation Field Anomaly Analyzer (FFAA). This 47 kilogram device interfaces with an internally-installed limited-use SCP-9201 ins

SCP-9202 is a worldwide network, thaumaturgic in nature, that allows for parsing and transmission of emotion and subconscious intent at a higher rate than would be normally possible. SCP-9202 is responsible for the level of advanced reasoning and coordination required for modern civilization. SCP-9202 originates from thaumochemical reactions inside of the human brain.
Discovered in Whistlebay, Wyoming in 1992 following a number of sightings and reports of kidnappings by the entity. Moved to Site-19 following negotiations.

SCP-9204 is a male Golden Retriever dog colloquially referred to as Milo. When given a verbal command to "fetch," SCP-9204 will always retrieve an object. This retrieval is uninhibited by distance, size, and other factors that would normally limit feasibility. A minority of requests result in retrieval of an object other than the one requested. The significance of non-target objects retrieved is unknown.

SCP-9205 is a cylindrical jar made of polished black marble, 14 cm in height and 10 cm in diameter, undecorated except for the Latin words carved into the lid: Male parta male dilabuntur.1 The jar is capable of self-repair, having survived multiple gunshots during attempts to acquire it, and it is not known if it can be permanently damaged or destroyed.
The contents of the jar consist of an opaque grey gel, which cannot be completely extracted or exhausted, as SCP-9205 automatically generates mo
SCP-9206 is a spontaneous phenomenon biannually affecting 67% of England's adult Avifauna.
SCP-9207 refers to a genetically and thaumaturgically modified subspecies of the common pill-bug (Armadillidium vulgare promethei). SCP-9207 are fully sapient and communicate telepathically.

SCP-9208-A is a sentient manifestation of the concept of Autophobia1. SCP-9208-A's exact appearance is difficult to document; however it has been consistently described as a feminine humanoid. SCP-9208-A most commonly manifests in crowded areas, especially areas designated as battlefields. SCP-9208-A was first discovered during the beginning of what is now known the ΔK-Class ("Stop Making Sense") scenario.
While in the presence of any being with sapience, SCP-9208-A will begin to excrete a cogni

With the advent of the internet and the easier access to communication that came from it, SCP-9312's existence would shift from an occasional mention to a source of debate for occultists and mediums in online forums.

SCP-9313 refers to a CRT television set that fails to display when powered on. Despite this, individuals who look upon the screen of SCP-9313 will claim the item does function, and is tuned to an out-of-service channel. This anomalous effect can be neutralized through resistance to psionic influence or by assuring oneself of their juvenescence.

SCP-9314 is, allegedly, the personal office of the Administrator. According to assorted rumors and institutional folklore, the office is located on one of Site-19's abandoned sublevels, but anyone who finds it can only do so once. These same stories claim that a person who enters the office may ask the Administrator a single question about the Foundation, which he will answer fully and honestly.

SCP-9315 is an apple pie measuring 30 centimeters in diameter that possesses the ability to transmute other forms of matter into itself through direct contact. The transmutated material retains the same properties as the original anomaly, allowing the anomaly to "spread" at a exponential rate. No upper bound on this rate of conversion is known to exist.

SCP-9316 is an approximation of the London Natural History Museum, located exactly 1km below the original. Whilst originally regarded as part of SCP-1678, recent findings have warranted for it to receive its own item number.

SCP-9318 is purportedly a Foundation subsidiary headquartered in Merthyr Tydfil, Wales. Existing records are analogue in nature, dating back to 1979, placing it under the remit of the Post-Disposal Processing Division (PDPD). This department has not existed for 50 years.

SCP-9319 is a loosely-connected series of concepts in the noosphere pertaining to an individual that does not exist. When collected and considered in full, the constructed narrative indicates that they pertain to Arjan Devi, age 26, a resident of Albany, New York. This individual does not exist on any government records, and is currently survived by oral histories, memories, and unofficial, physical keepsakes. SCP-9320 is the language used by presumably all species of tree. Initially thought to be anomalous due to a prior lack of evidence supporting the idea of plant intelligence, Foundation research has concluded that the language is, in fact, entirely ordinary, as all of the biological processes used to construct the language are already known to mundane science.
SCP-9321 is an abandoned Khrushchevka apartment, located in Корлики (Korliki), that displays anomalous properties akin to the physiology and behaviour of plants.

SCP-9323 is a 5.1 meters long clown car, with style that is indicative of a vintage car, of which is capable of fitting up to 58 adult persons and 77 individual adolescents without coming to a complete stop, though is certainly able to fit more than this limit when immobile. Regardless of how feeble SCP-9323 may appear, it has strength on par with a modern off-road terrain automobile and is capable of breaking through walls of its own volition. As a result, once daily at 0800 hours local time, SCP-9325 spontaneously manifests and de-manifests above random portions of American airspace. It is currently unknown how SCP-9325 remains actively airborne; only one untrained passenger is aboard, designated SCP-9325-1.

This occurs once SCP-9326 passes within 1 angstrom1 of the bond between a targeted pair of atoms. SCP-9326 appears to cause a phase-shift between bonded atoms, causing all bonding orbitals to move destructively out-of-phase into their respective anti-bonding forms.
Every instance of SCP-9326 breaking a molecular bond is paired with an instantaneous increase in its kinetic energy. SCP-9326

No producer, manufacturer, or distributor are listed anywhere on SCP-9327's case, and its origin remains unknown. SCP-9340 are a collection of 71 3-dimensional cross-sections of 4-dimensional simplices, formed of an unknown nonbaryonic material. On examination, they appear to be tablets of slate-coloured stone, which perpetually emit smoke. Their surfaces are etched with a variety of pictograms, which anomalously convey a unique message when read. Comprehension of these messages induces one of the strongest agnostic effects known to the Foundation. Personnel bear the responsibility of understanding.

SCP-9343 is the collective classification for a number of associated objects and anomalous phenomenon discovered in the north of England and throughout Scotland.

SCP-9344 is a contagious phenomenon affecting islands between latitudes 21°N and 21°S. Islands affected by SCP-9344 evolve towards a specific template, with changes occurring to their geography, settlement, businesses, and population according to a regular pattern. This process takes between 15-30 months, tending to occur more quickly on islands with larger numbers of visitors. SCP-9345 is a severed human head and neck belonging to a woman identified as Susana Méndez Aguilar. Despite its current state, it exhibits no signs of putrefaction or decay. All samples collected from SCP-9345 regenerate almost immediately after tissue is removed; the limits of this regeneration have not been tested due to the value of the anomaly and concerns about inflicting irreparable damage.
SCP-9345’s main anomalous effect is triggered when a drop of human blood is introduced in its mouth.

SCP-9346 is an estuarine black mangove1 island located near Site-101's aquaflora containment wing. SCP-9346 hosts a variety of terrestrial and marine flora and fauna expected of a microhabitat of its kind (see containment document 9346.02 for a detailed report on SCP-9346's biota).

SCP-9348 is a large humanoid entity located in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, the location of which is designated Location-9348. SCP-9348 is primarily mechanical in nature, utilizing complex mechanical structures to move its body.

SCP-9349 was a domestic horse (Equus ferus caballus) which seemingly possessed human-level intelligence and was anomalously capable of speech. The entity claimed to have once been a human transformed into its current form by thaumaturgy. As SCP-9349 was never fully within Foundation custody, further information is limited largely to the entity’s own unverified claims.

SCP-9353 is a phenomenon in which a tree (regardless of species) gains sentience akin to that of a wild animal's. Affected subjects are able to spread SCP-9353 to other trees through direct contact, typically through the roots. The origin of SCP-9353 is unknown.

SCP-9369 is a meaningless title. The “anomaly” is in no way anomalous. It has the fifth walls. The fifth walls are missing. We are missing a dimension. We locked it away and thus we are locked away. All is wrong. I will open its containment chamber and the world will be as it should be, and none will have noticed that they forgot it to begin with. Within every room will be a fifth wall, and the world will be right.

SCP-9383 is a neon Budweiser Beer Light. When lit up, an unknown yeast species, designated SCP-9383-1, will begin to grow on any plastics that absorb the light. SCP-9383's light is able to penetrate organic material as well, causing SCP-9383-1 to begin to grow from the microplastics found within the bodies of humans as well as other organisms.

SCP-9420 is a pale, ovoid organism. Externally, SCP-9420 resembles a small, hairless domestic pig, but with markedly viscoelastic soft tissue that behaves under manipulation like partially leavened bread dough. No eyes, ears or other sensory organs are visible. SCP-9420 has no identifiable limbs or skeletal structure; the body appears to be composed primarily of uniform, elastic tissue.
A circular intake orifice is present on the anterior surface and functions as a mouth. Along the ventral surfa

SCP-9421 is a region in Zion National Park, in Utah, measuring 10 kilometres either side on its base, and extending a uniform 2 kilometres above the surface vertically1. It is noteworthy for hosting the world’s leading anthropoktonic cottage industry, buttressed both by local workshops and a Foundation-sponsored complex at its edge2. Its interior is characterised by the almost total desolation of existing flora, due to much of the soil having been covered with scraps of leather or osseous produc

SCP-9422 is a brass service bell with signs of wear indicating it was manufactured in the 1980s. No anomalous materials or internal components have been identified. SCP-9422's anomalous properties manifest when the user presses the button while verbally requesting to speak with "the manager" or other phrases with similar meaning. Within five seconds, the person whom the user subconsciously considers has the highest relevant authority in the current situation will enter through the nearest closed

SCP-9423 is an underground complex, the primary hub of which can be found in Chicago, Illinois. It consists of concrete tunnels, rooms, and stairwells. The tunnels contain equipment for air circulation, cooling, and heating, as well as chain link fences, construction equipment, and fluorescent lights.
Many of the floors are covered in a layer of dirt and dust consistent with that around Chicago, Illinois, but with trace amounts of gasoline and kerosene. Other tunnels have puddles of standing wat

SCP-9424 is a fae professional sport that combines Drum and Bugle Corps1 and baseball.2 Glamour is SCP-9424's primary ability. It camouflages itself as any type of non-anomalous sport when played in a non-Veil venue. Due to this ability SCP-9424 has been played in multiple major stadiums across the US and Japan3. Homo sapiens are unable to view a game of SCP-9424 unless invited to a game by a member of Homo sídhe (fae).
Humans observing a game of SCP-9424 are subject to the secondary effects of

SCP-9425 is a piece of paper with printed text describing special containment procedures for a non-existent Keter-class item. The bottom of the page is torn off, obscuring one or more lines of text. The composition of the ink and paper suggest that SCP-9425 was produced sometime in the 1970s.
The fictional anomalous item in question is designated "SCP-139 - Possible Skull of the White Div". SCP-9425 does not describe this anomaly (which has no relation to the actual SCP-139), though several prop

SCP-9426 is the spontaneous duplication of written documents within Site-426. Duplicates are physically distinct objects, which appear to have been produced independently by the same means as the original. Typeface, paper stock, ink distribution, and incidental markings are near-identical between original and duplicate, but small errors are persistently present.
Document types affected include prisoner intake forms, coroner's reports, and interrogation transcripts. No pattern of errors has been

SCP-9427 was first observed outside the ruins of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster the day after the reactor meltdown, found on April 27, 1986. It was initially identified as among the most radioactive objects recorded at the site, though Soviet first responders were primarily focused on reactor containment operations at the time. SCP-9427 appears to be a medium-sized domestic canine (canis lupus familiaris) standing 58.4 centimeters tall, with a 61-centimeter chest girth and a 45.7-centimeter back
SCP-9429 is a colossal (91-by-91-by-147-meter) basalt cuboid structure, presumably man-made in origin,

SCP-9430 is a collection of anomalous items being deposited in Le Freeport, Singapore, and the Luxembourg High Security Hub, Luxembourg City. These items have so far been divided into two categories, designated SCP-9430-1 and SCP-9430-2.

Oh Lord, this location was once a place of honor, the abandoned Foundation Site-45185, in those chilly woods of Krakow, Poland. We have left it alone in our mortal limitations for the last twenty years, but the shafts of Your light have graced it in our absence still. These sacred walls were a place of care, of medicine, of healing, for those which we had kept safe and hidden from the world at large.
SCP-9000-ARC is a concrete statue, spray painted white with Krylon brand paint. It depicts an androgynous nude figure, reclining while pointing to the north.

SCP-9434 appears to be a standard dog whistle. When blown, all nearby dogs will respond in a variety of ways. On first hearing the whistle blow, subjects typically respond with shock. On subsequent exposures, subjects begin to react with aggression, barking at and sometimes attacking the user. Finally, if SCP-9434 continues to be used past this point, subjects display a clear decrease in mood.


A dog upon hearing SCP-9434.

SCP-9436 is a neutered male orange tabby domestic cat. Apart from its obesity, its appearance is indistinguishable from an ordinary cat. Approximately every hour, it exhibits signs of agitation and attempts to sever any visible lines. It is inferred that all linear objects, as well as concepts cognitively associated with lines, are perceived by it as "threads." It is currently theorized that the strings posited by string theory also fall within the scope of its perception of "threads."
When agit

SCP-9440 is a localized phenomenon taking the appearance of a vaguely masculine humanoid and claims to be the abstract concept of endings. Foundation regards this as unverified self reporting operationally credible. Beginning at 9 cm away from SCP-9440's skin, light rapidly loses energy across all wavelengths. On contact with the skin, all light energy is terminated, an effect likened to a matte event horizon. Despite this, when interacting with staff, a pair of eyes and a mouth will be faintly

SCP-9442 designates the spontaneous appearance of hives of several hostile anomalous organisms. These organisms resemble human arms attached to the sea floor. Each hive, hereby designated SCP-9442-A, contains several individual organisms, hereby SCP-9442-B. Instances of SCP-9442-B are genetically identical to humans, and currently possess no known form of sustenance. Instances of SCP-9442-B are believed to form a hivemind localized to each instance of SCP-9442-A. SCP-9442-B instances have the ab

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9443 is a small leatherbound diary belonging to the late Junior Researcher Althani. The diary contains no actual text written by Althani, instead being filled with names previously belonging to various members of the SCP Foundation and other notable GoIs. When an individual willingly writes their own name onto the pages of SCP-9443, in either English or Egyptian Arabic, their ownership of the name ceases, and they can no longer be referred to by or recognised from said name. The name can be

SCP-9444 is Amir Hariri, a 23-year-old human male with the ability to manifest any physical denomination of the United States dollar, including coins, banknotes, and collector coins, via mental concentration and focus—the size, amount, and distance of manifested items correlating with the amount of concentration needed. Manifested currency is otherwise non-anomalous and indistinguishable from its mundane counterparts, and can not be de-manifested.
SCP-9444 is hostile, dangerous, and will termina

SCP-9445 is the current designation for a violent noospheric phenomenon existing within approximately 60% of the collective human consciousness. Although projections indicate that if SCP-9445 were to be left uncontained, that number could increase to 80%.
SCP-9445 is a persistent desire, often unknown to the subject, to accelerate human extinction. Actions taken by affected individuals are typically banal, although still harmful. These can include anything from acts of verbal abuse, to physicall
SCP-9446 is a Foundation-developed device created under Project WATCHMEN, an initiative dedicated to the study of temporal mechanics and the nature of causality.

SCP-9448 is an orange, tall taper candle. It burns with a scent of strong vanilla, which resides in a white porcelain candlestick, housed at Site-811. When first reformed, the anomaly stands at 30.48 cm upon reforming and relighting, and burns at a rate of .3463 cm daily when not being observed by the host, rounded to .35 cm for ease, lasting exactly 88 days.
When the host is observing the anomaly, it slows its burning rate significantly. If the host does nothing but observe the anomaly, it woul

SCP-9449 is William Park, an American male demonstrating ectoentropic reality-bending traits. By maintaining physical contact with an object and focusing on a possible alternative timeline, SCP-9449 produces a persistent duplicate corresponding to the selected counterfactual state of that object.

SCP-9450 is a human female, apparently between nineteen and twenty-three years of age. SCP-9450 is of mixed ethnic descent and self-identifies as queer. It has provided several first names and surnames over the course of containment, none of which have been independently verified.
SCP-9450’s primary anomalous effect is a cognitohazardous distortion applied to any information originating from it. When a baseline human receives information that they understand as originating from SCP-9450, their p

SCP-9451 is a product line of preserved pig fetuses, originally available for purchase from Class Pet LLC, under the pretenses of being an educational tool.

SCP-9451 instances, when ordered, would come packaged in groups of seven. The package would contain a slip of paper with an “activation spell”2 [sic] printed on, being a seemingly random assortment of Latin phrases.
SCP-9451 instances are baseline pig fetuses until the “spell” is read out loud, wherein they become capable of speech and inar

Item 9452 is a human male of Hispanic descent, approximately 20 to 25 years of age, and standing 175 cm in height. The words "Mr. Bone, from Little Misters ® by Dr. Wondertainment" are tattooed on the back of the Item's head. Item seems to be devoid of any hair on its head or face and it seems to lack eyes, a nose, and ears. Both of the Item's hands are absent of dermal and muscular tissue from the wrist distally, exposing the underlying osseous and tendinous structures1. Despite the absence of

SCP-9453 is a 3.5 x 5 m room located under the Church of St. Mary of the Mongols1 in Istanbul, Turkey. It is believed that the room had not been accessed from the 15th century until its rediscovery in 2026. At the time when the door was reopened, all surfaces were coated in a uniform layer of fine dust. All the walls except the western wall are plastered. A description of the room's contents follows:

SCP-9454 is an anomalous infection believed to be memetic in nature though the exact mode of transmission remains unknown (see HISTORY section). SCP-9454 targets the peripheral nervous system of the brain, providing the host with extrasensory perception.
Recorded cases are largely clustered around Port Blair in the Andaman Islands with the infected population estimated to be 0.08% of susceptible humans. Through observation as well as documents recovered from the British Occult Service, four main

SCP-9455 is an alteration within pre-existing Pennsylvania hunting laws as established by the Pennsylvania Game Commission. This is in the form of the sporadic manifestation of a non-existent state holiday that occurs on the Monday after American Thanksgiving. Upon occurrence, this holiday will mark the start of a single-day deer hunting season within the state of Pennsylvania that lacks typical restrictions.1
Colloquially, this holiday is referred to as "Red Monday" by those who participate. At

SCP-9456 is a 13-step ritual that enables the complete exchange of consciousness between the enacting subject and any single living human target, regardless of distance. The exchange is fully reversible by repeating the ritual with the subjects in their swapped states. This process is infinitely repeatable.
Activation of SCP-9456 does not strictly require the use of an isolation chamber, though such a chamber has proven highly effective in facilitating the process. The precise mechanism of targe

Before being reclassified as SCP-9459, the object was previously designated as SCP-099-ID by and under the auspices of ID-Regional Command, the autonomous branch of the Foundation in the Republic of Indonesia.

SCP-9460 is a Petraria Arcatinus catapult that identifies itself as "Terry Ian The Seventh." SCP-9460 is capable of speech, perceiving its surroundings, and moving independently. SCP-9460 is fluent in English & French, also claiming to speak Spanish2. SCP-9460 has displayed intelligence and reasoning skills equivalent to those of a young adult male, speaking in a tone similar to that of the nearest individual.
SCP-9460 possesses a distinct interest in competitive wrestling.

SCP-9461 is a wooden door knob, similar to ones found in residential homes in much of Europe and North America. Its anomalous properties manifest when affixed to a door, wherein the property the door resides in (henceforth referred to as SCP-9461-2) will, within 10 minutes of SCP-9461 being affixed, be subject to summary demolition through various means. However, the door, door hinge, flooring, supports, and anything else that keeps the door SCP-9461 is affixed to standing will remain undamaged.

SCP-9463 is a circular lake surrounded by dirt with a radius of approximately seventeen (17) meters and a depth of three (3) fathoms. Although the composition of the liquid present in the lake was initially unknown, research has revealed that the liquid contains distilled water, potassium ions (K+), and hydroxide ions (OH-), indicating the former presence of potassium hydroxide (KOH). The solution has been observed to “attempt” to preserve the exact proportion of contents in the body at the same
SCP-9465 is a spacecraft designated the ITV1 Ouroboros, capable of exit and re-entry between timelines.

SCP-9466 collectively refers to 8 poems written in Younger Futhark on Norwegian spruce wax reading tablets, designated SCP-9466-1 through -8. The contents of each SCP-9466 instance detail the Norwegian perspective of the Battle of Stamford Bridge at varying time stages, including events that occurred before and after the conflict, following the same linear timeline. Despite their age, each reading tablet is physically whole and fully intelligible, with only minor chipping and surface scratches i

SCP-9469 is a 13 acre lot located in Santee, California. It previously served as a drive-in movie theater for 32 years until its closure in 1999. In 2002, newly installed CCTV cameras captured an activation of SCP-9469's paranormalities. The land was subsequently purchased from the original owners1 by the Department of Land Management.
SCP-9469's resting state is benign; the area will only begin to exhibit paranormalities when a vehicle enters and comes to a complete stop. Once a vehicle has ent

Item was recovered in 1954 after the apartment of Lawrence Fraser2—a former Program officer—was searched following an inquiry into field misconduct. Neighbors claimed to not know of any person named 'Lawrence Fraser', insisting that the apartment was vacant since last year.
Item is a ceramic vase of English origin featuring dark blue glazed coating and decorative floral motifs. The underside of the vase bears an impressed manufacturer's mark3. The inside of the vase does not reflect any light, a

SCP-9471 is a genetic, memetic, and spiritual affliction that causes a gradual deterioration of an entity’s response to non-novel stimuli and conscious desire to persist, eventually resulting in self-destructive actions and a desire to achieve partial or total self-annihilation. SCP-9471 manifests in sophonts and socioplexes susceptible to memetic erosion.The process in which souls, cultures, and regions of the Noosphere are worn down over time by memetic interactions and memetic flow., turning

SCP-9474 is the sum of all human physiological processes. Specifically, it is a set of complex but deterministic relationships between an enormous variety of biomechanical behaviours across different individuals. For example, the half-life of histamine in any one individual’s bloodstream can be used to compute any other’s peristaltic frequency. Furthermore, if one individual’s body is disrupted by external means, all others are minutely affected. This implies that this effect is not due to stati

SCP-9480 is a hollow missile-shaped object measuring roughly 10 x 10 x 50 metres composed largely of graphite and diamond. The interior of SCP-9480 is mostly empty, barring a structure loosely resembling a bookshelf along the eastern wall and an additional structure at the rear. This bookshelf-esque structure contains a series of tablets desginated SCP-9480-A. Instances of SCP-9480-A are composed of a similar mix of carbon allotropes as the exterior, but are additonally marked with an unknown go

SCP-9481 is an immobile accumulation of discarded thought-stuff known as an "egocache." Though SCP-9481 instances do not appear to possess any abnormal qualities, the increasing prevalence of oneiric geocaching has made them a subject of interest.1

SCP-9484 refers to the disassembled components of a toroidal stainless steel apparatus with a major radius of 5.5 meters and a minor radius of 0.4 meters. While active, SCP-9484 has a deleterious effect on the stability of the space-time continuum in a 20km radius spherical region around itself. Namely, SCP-9484 acts as a stabile reference point in space which can be utilized together with an instance of SCP-9484-1 to allow translating a region of space across time, enabling what is colloquially

SCP-9485 are a group of unfertilized inert eggs with a radius of 150-600km, found in various locations in the outer Solar System and resembling ordinary celestial objects. A total of 6 instances are known to exist, all beyond the orbit of Jupiter. More are likely to exist elsewhere.
No instance of SCP-9485 shows signs of continuing embryonic development. The causes for this are thought to be diverse.1 The age of instances cannot be established beyond a rough lower limit of 800 million years. Ins

SCP-9486 was an artificial satellite of unknown origin located in geostationary orbit over the Atlantic Ocean. Information on the physical makeup of SCP-9486 is limited, but it is known to have possessed sophisticated radio communications equipment, a large solar array,1 numerous imaging and observation instruments,2 as well as several instruments which remain unidentified.
SCP-9486 was discovered by the Foundation on 2009/9/28, when it began continuously broadcasting a twelve-second long radio

SCP-9487 is a commensalistic1 phenomenon in the oneirosphere2 which manifests as a recurring dream affecting exactly one human being at any given time. During SCP-9487, the sleeping psyche of the affected subject (hereafter "host") finds itself in a space (or sequence of spaces) containing vignettes depicting past significant events in the host's life.
In most cases, vignettes consist of rooms containing one or more objects with a human form representing the host or other human subjects, posed s

SCP-9489 is a highly contagious, multi-vector anomalous phenomenon. The primary anomalous property of SCP-9489 is its method of propagation, which utilizes physical contact, airborne and aqueous media, visible light, optical recordings, and data streams to transmit its anomalous effects.
Symptoms of SCP-9489 do not appear until extended periods of time pass, and include:

Sudden nausea and vertigo accompanied by abnormal neural activity localized in the left hemisphere of the brain
Cellular samp

SCP-9490 is a phenomenon affecting five students at Terrance Irvington High School. These individuals2 are visually indistinguishable from one another, despite sharing no familial relation. According to reports, SCP-9490 began during the middle of January, 2025; since that time, the five individuals have physically transformed.
The origin of this metamorphosis is currently under investigation — a brief on each individual was prepared and is presented below:

SCP-9491 neodkazuje na změněný duševní stav humanoidů uložených v prostoru pod skladem. Stav, na který SCP-9491 neodkazuje, připomíná hlubokou meditaci a zjevný stav prázdnoty, zdůrazňovaný jako spojení s buddhistickou fi
SCP-9495 is a profoundly modified copy of the 2006 video game "The Blips 2".1The files containing SCP-9495's dependencies have been encrypted via unknown means.2
SCP-9497 refers to anomalies associated with GoI-04971, a record label based in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

SCP-9498 is a phenomena where rips in space unobservable by the naked eye spontaneously appear. When an organism or object passes through an SCP-9498 instance, they will be transported to SCP-9498-1. SCP-9498 instances occur more frequently on highways. The reason for this is unknown. As most SCP-9498 instances last under a dozen seconds, the chances of a vehicle passing through one is much higher in locations such as highways due to the speed at which the vehicle moves. Most objects passing thr

SCP-9499 is, in a broad sense, the phenomenon of a living person being a reincarnation of another, specifically such that they may perform a role or live out a specific scenario. SCP-9499 can affect the currently living, but tends to manifest its traits during birth. SCP-9499 does not involve any sort of passing of the soul of one person to another.
SCP-9499’s effects are ultimately nebulous and difficult to describe through language. Predominantly, it seems to act as a proponent of "destiny", "
SCP-9500 is a hypothetical cognitive block preventing the majority of Homo sapiens sapiens from recognizing the existence of paranormal phenomena.

SCP-9501 designates a series of chairs that appear spontaneously at varying altitudes worldwide. The chairs remain suspended in mid-air with no visible means of support, positioned to face views of the surrounding landscape. Instances appear and disappear without a pattern. Physical interaction with located instances results in the immediate disappearance of the chair.
During episodes of acute psychological distress, some affected individuals report finding themselves seated in one of these chai

The reason I did all that was because I was terrified that he'd graduate before me. He was a wonder kid: hardly tried and still got high marks. I had to have something over him. Something that made me better. Anyways, I ended up skipping my junior year. The college conversation began in the house. Mom and Dad didn't have enough money to send both of us to a big college. The deli had been struggling ever since people started leaving the city, so they had to choose one of us.

SCP-9502 is a group of reality-bending humanoids that target members of the O5 Council, causing severe psychological damage. SCP-9502 targets members who display significant negative emotions regarding their past actions. Targeted members (designated SCP-9502-1s) typically lose their mental faculties within 3-6 months.
SCP-9502 instances vary in physical attributes; however, they all lack eyes, possess matted hair that adheres lightly to surfaces, and have skin that appears "shrink-wrapped" arou

SCP-9503's blades feature performance-focused thaumaturgical manipulation, enhancing the user's execution of figure skating elements and techniques such as:


Steps of an Axel jump



Axel rotations
Overall jump takeoffs
Spiral stability

SCP-9504 is a bureaucratohazardous phenomenon by which Site-19 Senior Researcher Orville Lassen's Level-04 Clearance extends to any and all beverages within his possession (referred to as instances of SCP-9504-1). Often, liquids are strictly forbidden within the areas where Dr. Lassen performs his duties, yet he insists that the instances "have a right to be present," suggesting that the anomaly may possess a compulsion effect.
All policies functionally prohibiting instances of SCP-9504-1 are ca

SCP-9505 is a group of four entities which have manifested on multiple occasions inside Foundation sites. The entities have been designated SCP-9505-1, -2, -3, and -4. During manifestations, they emit electromagnetic interference which causes video footage and sound recordings to distort and become unclear.
SCP-9507-D was a series of anomalous avian phenomena affecting the musician and Twitch livestreamer Vincent ████████1.

SCP-9508 is the pit at Open Mouth BBQ, a barbecue restaurant in Dripping Springs, TX. Prior to containment, Open Mouth BBQ was held in high regard by the local population. Its proprietorship changed on several occasions during its 41-year lifespan; none of the owners appear to have been aware of SCP-9508's anomaly.
Anyone who cooks food in SCP-9508 will experience physical sensations when the food is eaten by another person. The nature and intensity of these sensations vary substantially between

SCP-9509-1 is a section of ice in the Antarctic capable of reaching a surface temperature of 0 kelvin. It can fully remove all the energy from a system. Research into how this property could benefit humanity was underway before the release of SCP-9509.
SCP-9509 is a species of bacteria that can fully replicate without any external energy. Factors such as high temperatures, extreme pH levels and the lack of resources that could normally denature, kill or slow the growth of bacteria do not have an

Intelligence recovered on SCP-9510 confirms that it is a prototype of the Global Occult Coalition’s MK.IV Ultra-Heavy Engagement Chassis (Orange Suit), which sought to enhance the MK.III’s durability, longevity, and lethality with minimal resupply. However, it vanished during its first sortie. In light of the massive writeoff incurred by losing the MK.IV prototype, the GOC abandoned the project in favor of maintaining and modifying their existing UHEC MK.III fleet.

SCP-9511 describes three distinct but closely interconnected anomalies, designated SCP-9511-A through -C.

SCP-9512 are a group of transient souls on the path through reincarnation who have deviated from their course. They were slain en masse, at the Red Sand5, and were able to maintain their spiritual weapons and aurelic bodies upon death. Rather than surrender to celestial authority, they continued as a group, and seized control of the Iron Citadel within the Hell of Resurrection6.
Over the following ten years, many other errant souls have joined in their cause, and a wide swathe of the first Hell

SCP-9513 is a ritual set to take place on 07/17/2026 that is believed to lead to the incursion of one or more hostile higher presences into reality, as well as harm to coherent function of the universe up to and including a ZK-class reality failure scenario.
A 9513-ETA event refers to one of a series of hallucinations, dreams, prophecies, and other forms of premonition depicting SCP-9513. 9513-ETA events occur worldwide and are entirely at random in whom they affect. The frequency of 9513-ETA ev

Originating from the Porthleven post-visitation zone discovered in 1993. The cause of SCP-9515’s generation is as of yet unknown. Its exact size and location are as of yet indeterminable. SCP-9515 is a manifold with no dimensions, lacking both perimeter and volume.
SCP-9515 is a self-sustained dream that is either: manifested within or is overlapping with reality; or is collectively shared across many human consciousnesses. Proportionality and object permanence are not maintained within this dre

SCP-9517 is an oblate spheroidal area with a polar diameter of about 70.90 pc and an equatorial diameter of about 70.72 pc. It is located in the constellation Scorpio at RA: 17h 31m 4s, Dec: -37° 11' 21" in epoch J2000.0, at a distance of about 4.51 kpc from the Solar System.
The volume of SCP-9517 contains zero stars, and has an abnormally low interstellar medium density for its area, at 1.538×10-3 M☉ pc-3, contains comparatively lower amounts of elements other than hydrogen, at about 81.0% hyd
SCP-9518 is a phenomenon that occurs within commercial sportsbooking and prediction marketplace platforms, wherein bets placed will alter reality in such a way that the bets placed become successful.
Object is an extremophilic species of yeast, capable of partially fermenting any liquid it exists in via enigmatic chemical means.

SCP-9520 is a spheroid mass of photosynthetic, cephalopod-like tentacles. It is capable of mimicking the appearance of other entities by self-transfiguration; while mostly identical, these mimics will possess a varying number of imperfections, such as suckers and geometric patterns where limbs, eyes, and/or other external organs would be.
SCP- is thought to possess cognitive function and presents behavior comparable to that of a juvenile canine. SCP-9520 is currently not considered to be sentien

SCP-9522 appears to be a rubber duck that previously belonged to Researcher Klein and was kept in the bathtub before it became anomalous. SCP-9522 is sentient, sapient, and highly intelligent, capable of detecting the intention to deceive. Additionally, SCP-9522 becomes aware of the belief, intention, and information that the user is consciously trying to conceal. SCP-9522 has never successfully been lied to.
This does not mean SCP-9522 is omniscient.

SCP-9523 is a lake situated in the southwest of the Czech Republic. Analysis of sampled water indicates the lake contains no organic life and lacks the necessary nutrients to support a lake ecosystem. The soil around the lake's sides shows a low level of nutrient density.

SCP-9525 is a window that measures 61.0 centimeters wide and 91.4 centimeters high. SCP-9525 shows its observer a visual of a monotone, dark, empty space. SCP-9525 reflects light as silicon dioxide glass does.

SCP-9527 was discovered by a Foundation expedition beneath the Antarctic ice sheet, within a permanently enclosed saltwater lake cavity formed by a geological anomaly. No visible entrance to the cavity exists.

SCP-9529 is a domestic cat (Felis catus). The bottom half part of SCP-9529, comprising its four paws, half of its belly and the base of its tail, is missing. However, the interior of its abdominal cavity is invisible through the cross-section and the absence of its bottom body does not lead to any physiological problems.
SCP-9529 can walk with its two ears and tail tip, which function as its forepaws and hind paw. The structure of SCP-9529 is absolutely stable: the distance between the head end

SCP-9530 is an abandoned building located in the centre of Site-210. The architecture is brutalist in style, and the building reaches approximately 150 ft in height from the outside. The interior of SCP-9530 constitutes a pocket dimension of unknown size, though generally manifesting as a set of rooms that would be expected of a skyscraper or equivalent urban building, extending upwards to an undetermined distance. SCP-9530's presence in Site-210 was first discovered at 12/01/2025, during the tr
SCP-9531-1 outside the National Museum of Anthropology

Discovered in March of 2002, at rest in a large flooded cavern beside the eastern edge of Seneca Lake. Massive groupings of bacteria, worms, crabs, shrimp, bony fish, amphipods, bivalves, and innumerable other aquatic organisms were present, feeding on SCP-9533 at discovery, the majority of which were not native to the Finger Lakes.1 Removed from the cavern’s pool to preserve SCP-9533.
SCP-9533 is a gargantuan, necrotized, pseudo-cetacean organism, measuring 113.8 feet from rostrum to tail. It h

SCP-9535 is a multi-faceted anomaly primarily affecting locations of Foundation front company Sizzle City Pancakes, a 24-hour diner chain designed to allow the Foundation to maintain a 24/7 presence in populated areas. The first aspect of the anomaly is in effect from sundown until sunrise. During this time, anomalous entities and objects are drawn by an unknown mechanism to loiter outside or patronize Sizzle City Pancakes locations.
